jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Analytics Engineer

The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.

Our current data platform includes:

  • Ingestion: Stitch

  • Data warehouse: BigQuery

  • Transformation: dbt Cloud

  • Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight


What you’ll do

  • Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.

  • Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.

  • Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.

  • Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

  • AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

  • Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table.

Working with AI

AI is part of how we work every day and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye.

The Team

You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max, Data Insights, as part of our small Data team on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. 


Who you are

  • You have owned analytics engineering work end-to-end.

  • You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core).

  • You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec.

  • You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language.

  • You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce.

  • You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled.

  • You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering.

How we hire

There are three stages:

  • 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

  • 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task.

  • 30-minute conversation with a member of the Exec team.

What we have for you

Competitive compensation  

  • 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked in the Summer months when team targets are met

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact  

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.  
     

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number.

 

Here’s what our users say:  

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★  

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★  

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

Right now, we're a team of 35 people spread globally. Small enough to know each other's names, big enough to have real impact. As we grow, everything changes. How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally.

Your Goal: Own the Full Employee Journey

As our Senior HR Business Partner, you'll take everything we've built so far and make it your own. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here. 

You will:

jobs.title: Clinical Lead, Women's Health
jobs.description:
Clinical Lead, Women's Health

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

💜 The role

Women's bodies are different, yet medicine still treats them the same. Women get diagnosed about 4 years later than men on average across 700+ types of disease. In France, 51% of women say a health professional has played down their symptoms at least once.

We want to change that. We are building the health system women never had: one that listens to women, anticipates their needs at every stage of life instead of waiting for problems to appear, and gives them care they can trust. To do this, we combine the latest evidence, digital tools, AI and carefully selected health professionals with our strength as an insurer.

We are looking for a doctor who wants to do medicine differently: to build products that thousands of women use and that address their needs; to move care towards prevention; and to work every day with people who think differently, such as product managers, designers, engineers and marketers.

As our Clinical Lead for Women's Health, you make this clinically credible and effective. You own the clinical choices, and you are an essential and active contributor in the product team.

A few things to know before you apply

  • This is a clinical role inside a product team, at an early stage. You own the clinical choices and you build the product with project builder, engineers, designers, ... A good product combines many factors, and the clinical side is one of them. There is a lot to build, to test and to change, and not everything is proven yet. For example, we measure how much our services are used much better than the health outcomes they achieve: building that measurement, honestly, is part of the job.

  • You work outside the usual medical world. Most of your colleagues are not health professionals. You will confront perspectives, explain clinical constraints in simple words, listen to product and business constraints, and find solutions together. Decisions are discussed and made as a team.

  • It takes real time. We prefer 80% or more; at least 60% is possible.

What you will do

You will be the clinical lead of our Women's Health offer, and you will help turn it into a product that women use and trust.

  • Build the product with the team. Work closely with product managers, designers and engineers, and bring the clinical view early, when it shapes decisions, not at the end. With AI tools, you can also build simple things yourself, without knowing how to code.

  • Own the clinical choices. Define our clinical positions based on evidence, design protocols and care pathways, and hold a few clear, explained red lines. When something doesn't work, you help find a safe and relevant alternative.

  • Make our AI safe and accurate on women's health. Work with the product team on how Mo, our AI-powered health companion, handles women's health topics, and help evaluate and improve it.

  • Show the value for women. Help define how we measure the impact on women's health, using evidence-based tools and value-based healthcare principles.

  • Work with our Clinic team. Work hand in hand with Alan's doctors, midwives and other health professionals: help train and support them, and be the person they turn to for difficult cases.

  • Feed and endorse our medical communication. Make sure what we say about women's health is accurate and evidence-based, and help explain it in simple words. Over time, you may represent Alan on these topics.

What success looks like in 6 months

  • Product: you are a core member of the product team, and the first member journeys reflect your clinical input from the start.

  • Protocols in use: the clinical protocols and care pathways of our first women's health program are validated and applied by the Clinic team.

  • Clinic team: midwives and doctors on the program are trained on the protocols, clinical staffing is under way, and you supervise complex cases.

  • Health outcomes: the program's health outcomes are defined and tracked.

  • AI quality: you have helped us make sure our AI handles women's health safely and accurately.

What this role is not

  • Not a medical advisor or reviewer who comes in at the end, nor the person who decides alone.

  • Not the person who runs all the consultations: our midwives and doctors do that, and you design, pilot and supervise.

  • Not an expert on every topic: you bring in other health professionals when needed.

A dynamic, international community of health professionals

You don't work alone. You join Alan's health professionals community: a large network of doctors, midwives, psychologists and other clinicians in France, Spain, Belgium and Canada, and a small core team of Alaners, other clinical leads working on different health programs or services. It is a community with high standards, direct and caring feedback, and a lot of room to shape things.

Beyond Women's Health, you will:

  • Share your practice and learn from others through case reviews and community sessions;

  • Help set common standards across programs;

  • Help welcome, train and mentor new health professionals joining Alan;

  • Help other teams at Alan understand key health concepts, such as evidence-based care;

  • Over time, contribute to other health topics beyond Women's Health.

👀 Is it you we're looking for?

Must-haves

  • You are a gynecologist (OB-GYN) or a GP with solid training in women's health, for example a university diploma (DU or DIU) in gynecology, or several years of regular gynecological follow-up in your practice. You can come from private practice, a hospital, a clinic or a health tech company.

  • At least 5 years of post-residency experience, with solid clinical judgment and evidence-based prescribing.

  • Clinical experience across several areas of women's health, for example contraception, fertility, endometriosis, menopause or hormone treatments.

  • An open, pragmatic mindset: you enjoy working with non-medical teams, you make trade-offs when they are legitimate while defending evidence-based rigor, and you are curious about what AI and digital tools change in medicine.

  • Outcomes thinking: you care about the results that matter to patients compared with what care costs (value-based healthcare), and about prevention, not only treatment.

  • A great understanding of the French healthcare system.

  • Fluency in both French and English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience training or supervising other health professionals is a plus, and a collaborative approach with midwives, dietitians, therapists, …

  • Experience in digital health, a start-up, a healthcare project or teleconsultation.

  • Experience writing or contributing to a clinical protocol or guideline.

🤝 How we work

  • Contract: you join Alan as an employee, ideally at 80% or more, and at least 60%. You can keep some clinical practice outside Alan.

  • Team: you are part of the Women's Health product team and of Alan's health professionals community.

  • Location: our headquarters are in Paris. You can be based abroad, as long as you speak French fluently and know the French healthcare system well.

  • Remote work: we offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🔄 What to expect from our recruitment process

  1. Application Review: we read your CV and application.

  2. Screening interview (45 to 60 minutes): your path, your motivation for this role, and practical points such as your availability.

  3. Technical interview: a short written case at home (60 to 90 minutes), including a situation where clinical and product needs conflict, then a live discussion of your answers.

  4. Alaner Fit interview: a conversation about how we work at Alan and whether it suits you.

  5. Alan Day: an on-site day where you prepare concrete use cases, present them to a panel and meet the people you would work with.

  6. Reference calls, including at least one with a non-medical colleague you have worked with.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

💡 You want to know more about Alan?

  • Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

  • Check out our About Alan and Career pages for more info.

  • You will own your projects and your priorities, juggle several topics at once, and be trusted to find our own solutions rather than simply following market practice.

  • We also like to explore how AI and automation can improve legal work, from drafting and research to repetitive tasks.

You have co-built features with Product teams, owned your own workstreams from start to finish, taken on complex health topics, and widened your scope. jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description:
Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment

Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge

Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.

Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.

We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch.

What You'll Do

Keep things running

  • Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks.

  • Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

  • Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most.

  • Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

  • Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute.


What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

  • Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

  • Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion.

  • Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills).

  • A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute.

  • You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks.

Nice to have

  • Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers.

  • Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost.

  • Experience with Omni dashboards.

Who You Are

  • Strategic and hands-on: You can think about where our payments set-up should go in the morning and fix a failing provider flow by lunch.

  • An owner: You pick up a seat that isn't yours after about two weeks of handover and run it without needing a brief, then hand it back in better shape than you found it.

  • Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess.

  • A bridge between teams: You work easily between Finance, Product, Support and external providers, and you explain things clearly in written English.

  • Invested in the person on the other end: You see a failed payment as someone who couldn't call home, and that makes you want to fix it properly.

Finance Controller

Finance Controller

Location: Netherlands

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €70k - €80k annually (depending on experience)

Employment type: Full-time (contractor if outside Netherlands)

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We are looking for a Finance Controller to own DTACT’s finance function end-to-end as we continue to scale internationally. Reporting into the COO, you’ll take full ownership of accounting, collections, financial analytics, budgeting, and compliance (including our Dutch statutory obligations) — acting as the single point of accountability for finance in the business today. This is a hands-on, mid-level role: you’ll be expected to run the entire finance function largely on your own in the near term, while also bringing the leadership mindset and ambition to grow the function — and your own role — as DTACT expands.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end accounting operations — AP/AR, general ledger, and month end/year-end close — ensuring accurate, timely financial reporting.

  • Manage the full collections process: invoicing, aging follow-up, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Build and maintain finance analytics (dashboards, reports) that give leadership clear, real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Own the budgeting and forecasting cycle, partnering with department leads to track actuals against plan.

  • Ensure full compliance with Dutch tax and statutory reporting requirements (VAT, annual accounts) and manage relationships with external accountants, auditors, banks, and tax advisors.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll processing and accuracy across jurisdictions, and own administration of the employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

  • Build and continuously improve finance processes, technical efficiencies and controls, laying the groundwork as the company grows.

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years of progressive finance/accounting experience, including hands-on ownership of a full finance function — ideally within tech in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch accounting standards, tax regulations, statutory compliance requirements and payroll.

  • Proven ability to independently manage accounting, collections, budgeting, and financial analytics without a large supporting team.

  • Strong analytical skills and financial modeling ability; comfortable turning data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Leadership potential and genuine ambition to grow into a finance leadership role as the team and company scale.

  • A hands-on, “roll up your sleeves” attitude, paired with the ability to think and plan strategically.

  • Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

jobs.title: Events Supplier Manager
jobs.description:
Events Supplier Manager

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
The Events Supplier Manager owns Perk Events' global supplier relationships and commercial agreements. Suppliers are the venues, hotels, agencies and event services behind every event we sell: venues, hotel groups, DMCs, catering, AV, transport, entertainment and activities. Most of the focus for this role will be on hotels to start, but with room to expand scope as we grow.

Today, most supplier deals are negotiated event by event by our Events Specialists and Customer Success Managers. This role builds the layer above that. You set the global supplier strategy, secure preferred agreements, build supplier relationships and give the team better rates, terms and margin on every event.

This is a global role, split roughly as follows:

  • Supplier strategy and agreements (60%): decide which suppliers we focus on, negotiate preferred agreements and run the supplier programme.

  • Deal support and performance (40%): help the team win and deliver large or complex events with the best rates/terms possible, and track how suppliers perform.

What You’ll Do

Supplier strategy

  • Build and own our preferred supplier programme across our key event markets globally.

  • Decide where we need more supply, using data on what customers ask for and where we lose deals

  • Set clear supplier tiers, with defined benefits for the suppliers that bring us the most business

  • Partner with Perk Supplier Relations team to ensure we have a consistent supplier strategy across transient and Groups/MICE business

Negotiation and agreements

  • Negotiate preferred agreements with venues, hotel groups, DMCs and other suppliers: rates, commission, payment terms, cancellation and attrition terms, and added extras for customers

  • Agree group and room block terms, working with the Hotel Supplier Partnerships team so hotel partners hear from one Perk

  • Manage renewals and renegotiate when terms or volumes change

  • Own contract templates and keep supplier terms consistent

Supporting the team

  • Join negotiations on large or complex events when Events Specialists and CSMs need support

  • Give the team a simple guide to preferred suppliers and the best deal for each type of event

  • Provide training to upskill our Events Specialists and CSMs on supplier negotiation

  • Pass on supplier feedback and market changes (pricing, availability, new venues) to keep the Events team informed

  • Partner with our dedicated Builders squad to shape our product, ensuring that your work with suppliers connects with customer experience in the product

Supplier performance

  • Track each supplier's volume, margin, commission, customer feedback and delivery quality

  • Run regular reviews with top suppliers, provide reporting, feedback and act when quality drops

  • Check new suppliers before we work with them: insurance, licences, financial stability

  • Report on supplier results and opportunities to the Perk Events leadership team

  • Lead Perk Events supplier days, partnering with the Supplier Relations team

Relationships and presence

  • Build long-term relationships with senior contacts at key suppliers

  • Represent Perk Events at industry events, trade shows and supplier visits, with some travel

KPIs

  • Margin and commission earned from suppliers

  • Share of events booked with preferred suppliers

  • Value of savings and extras secured for customers

  • Supplier quality and customer feedback scores

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 to 6+ years in Hotels, MICE, corporate events, hospitality sales, venue sourcing or supplier management

  • Proven record of negotiating commercial agreements with hotels (required), and venues, DMCs or event suppliers (plus)

  • Strong with numbers: comfortable working out margin, commission and the real cost of a deal in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Clear communicator who builds trust with suppliers and colleagues

  • Able to manage many suppliers and deadlines at once, with little supervision

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • Willing to travel to supplier meetings and industry events

Nice to have

  • Experience in an events agency, TMC, hotel sales team or event technology company

  • Salesforce and Cvent experience

  • Event certifications (for example CMP or CMM)

  • Spanish or another European language

  • Strong knowledge of venues and destinations in Europe or North America

What makes you succesfull here?

  • Commercial: you know what a good deal looks like and push for it

  • Relationship-focused: suppliers want to work with you

  • Practical: you build simple processes the team actually uses, you are ready to build a new program from scratch

  • An owner: you take responsibility for supplier results, good and bad

  • Collaborative: you work as one team with Events Specialists, CSMs, Account Managers and Hotel Supplier Partnerships

  • Ready to build: comfortable in a scale-up that moves fast, you are excited to proactively define new processes rather than being given a playbook.

Why Perk Events?

  • Build the supplier programme for a new and growing part of Perk

  • See your work in the numbers: better margin, better rates, happier customers

  • Work alongside Events, Account Management and Hotel Supplier Partnerships as one connected group

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Product Partnerships

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

#LI-Hybrid

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Development Representative I to our Sales team in Munich!

In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of creating new business opportunities and connecting companies with a solution that genuinely impacts their employees’ wellbeing. You will identify and engage prospects through creative outreach, build meaningful relationships with decision-makers, uncover key needs, and confidently articulate the value of Wellhub. Working closely with the Sales organization, you will navigate objections, turn conversations into pipeline, and take end-to-end ownership from initial touchpoint through qualification in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Manage client expectations, navigate objections, and maintain momentum from initial connection to qualified opportunity.
  • Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and pipeline generation targets.
  • Demonstrate the value of Wellhub by articulating the ROI of corporate wellness and educating companies on our mission.
  • Serve as the go-to subject matter expert on target industries and market segments across diverse sectors and geographies.
  • Network proactively with prospective clients and key stakeholders at industry conferences and field events.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • An articulate communicator with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish, capable of engaging internal and external stakeholders effectively.
  • A collaborative team player who thrives on shared success while maintaining tenacity and ownership over individual targets.
  • A strategic problem-solver capable of absorbing data and market insights to build analytically backed outreach strategies.

For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Sales or Business Development and bilingual communication skills in English and German are mandatory requirements.

Werkstudent*in Communications and Social Media

Das ISD ist ein globaler Think-and-Do-Tank, der sich dem Schutz von Demokratie und Menschenrechten widmet und Lösungen gegen instrumentalisierten Hass, Polarisierung, Desinformation und Extremismus weltweit entwickelt. Das ISD verbindet Forschung und Analyse mit Regierungsberatung sowie der Konzeption und Durchführung internationaler Trainings-, Bildungs- und Kommunikationsprogramme, um evidenzbasierte Antworten auf diese Herausforderungen umzusetzen. Die ISD-Teams sind in London, Amman, Berlin und Washington, DC angesiedelt.

Warum für das ISD arbeiten?

Das ISD ist kein gewöhnlicher Think Tank. Wir verwandeln Forschung in Maßnahmen, die die Welt verändern. Unsere Erkenntnisse verstauben nicht in Schubladen, sie stärken den Kampf für Demokratie und Menschenrechte an vorderster Front. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, echten Wandel zu bewirken, vom lokalen bis zum globalen Niveau. Wir suchen engagierte Menschen, die unsere Leidenschaft teilen, einen Unterschied zu machen. Werde Teil einer Organisation, die wirkliche Wirkung erzielt.

Die Leitprinzipien des ISD – Integrität, Zusammenarbeit, Flexibilität und Courage – prägen, wer wir als Team und Organisation sind. Diese Prinzipien spiegeln unsere Kultur wider und leiten unser Handeln und unsere Entscheidungen.

 Unsere Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten mit Home-Office nach Prinzipien von Vertrauen, Kommunikation und Flexibilität.

  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelungen.

  • 1 zusätzliche Woche bezahlter Urlaub über Weihnachten, zusätzlich zum regulären Urlaubsanspruch.

  • Home-Office-Zuschuss

Gehalt

€18 brutto pro Stunde

Arbeitsort

Der Arbeitsort kann unser Büro in Berlin sein oder in einer hybriden Arbeitsform nach Absprache. Die Bewerber*innen müssen über eine Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland verfügen. Eine Visa-Sponsoring-Möglichkeit besteht für diese Stelle nicht.

Vertragsart

Start: 04.01.2027; befristet bis 31.12.2027; Teilzeit 20 Stunden pro Woche

Gleichberechtigung, Vielfalt und Inklusion

ISD verpflichtet sich zur Förderung von Diversität in der gesamten Belegschaft und strebt ein Team an, das die Gesellschaft in all ihren Facetten widerspiegelt. Wir setzen alles daran, dass unser Arbeitsplatz, unsere Personalpolitik und unsere Organisationskultur ein inklusives, positives und fortschrittliches Umfeld schaffen, in dem alle Teammitglieder mit Würde und Respekt behandelt werden. Für weitere Informationen zu dieser Richtlinie oder unseren Rekrutierungspraktiken kontaktieren Sie bitte .

Wir begrüßen besonders Bewerbungen von People of Color, Personen der LGBTQ+-Community, Menschen mit Behinderungen, neurodivergente Personen, Pflegepersonen und Menschen aus unterschiedlichen sozioökonomischen Hintergründen.



Deine Aufgabe:

Wir suchen ab sofort eine*n engagierte*n Werkstudent*in Communications & Social Media, der*die unser Kommunikationsteam in Berlin unterstützt. Du berichtest an unsere*n Senior Communications Consultant und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg*innen aus den Analysis-, Advisory- und Action-Teams des ISD zusammen.

Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, dafür zu sorgen, dass die Forschung des ISD Germany möglichst viel Wirkung entfaltet. Dazu gehören: Beiträge und Datenvisualisierungen für die Website von ISD Germany erstellen, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle betreuen sowie Medienanfragen und Medienkontakte managen. Dabei achtest du darauf, dass unsere Kommunikation zeitlich gut mit politischen Ereignissen, Nachrichtenlagen und Veröffentlichungsterminen abgestimmt ist. Außerdem unterstützt du bei der Pflege unseres CRM-Systems monday.com, wirkst an laufenden Projekten der verschiedenen ISD-Entitäten mit und bist Schnittstelle zwischen unterschiedlichen Teams.

Voraussetzungen: Für eine Tätigkeit als Werkstudent*in ist es notwendig, dass du aktuell an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben bist und eine gültige Immatrikulationsbescheinigung vorlegen kannst.


Verantwortlichkeiten

  1. Kommunikationsoutputs

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Kommunikationsformaten für LinkedIn und andere Social-Media-Kanäle

  • Verfassen, Abstimmen und Veröffentlichen von Beiträgen für Social Media

  • CMS-Management, Pflege und Aktualisierung der Website

  • Entwicklung von Websiteformaten, Newsletter und ggf. einer Substack-Präsenz in Absprache mit dem*der Senior Communications Consultant

  • Verfassen, Abstimmen und Veröffentlichen von Blogposts

  • Anlegen und Veröffentlichen regelmäßiger Analyseformate und Forschungsergebnisse

  • Bearbeitung von Medienanfragen und Platzierung der Forschungsergebnisse von ISD Germany in den Medien

2. Datenvisualisierung

  • Erstellung von Datenvisualisierungen für unterschiedliche Kommunikationsprodukte, darunter Präsentationen, E-Mails und Berichte

  • Datenvisualisierungen für Social Media und Website

  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung monatlicher E-Mails mit Forschungsergebnissen für wichtige Stakeholder

3. Daten- und Kontaktmanagement / Administration

  • Organisation von und Teilnahme an ausgewählten Meetings

  • Nachverfolgung und Dokumentation von Medienengagement in monday.com

  • Aktualisierung von Publikationskalendern

  • Unterstützung bei laufenden Projekten der verschiedenen ISD-Entitäten (z. B. projektspezifische Newsletter)

Dein Profil

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben.

  • Du teilst die Mission des ISD und interessierst dich für sozialen Zusammenhalt, die Prävention von gewaltbereitem Extremismus und/oder Desinformation.

  • Du hast exzellente Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, jeweils in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, flüssig und präzise, mündlich wie schriftlich.

  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und mit einem Auge fürs Detail.

  • Du bist organisiert, flexibel, behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick und packst Dinge proaktiv an.

  • Du arbeitest sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team effektiv und gehst lösungsorientiert an Aufgaben heran.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office und hast erste Erfahrungen in einem Büroumfeld gesammelt.

Von Vorteil sind:

  • Ein Studium im Bereich Journalismus, Kommunikation, Medien- oder Kulturwissenschaften

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. monday.com) und CMS (z. B. WordPress)

  • Erfahrung mit Social Media und Community Management, insbesondere auf LinkedIn

  • Erfahrung im journalistischen Schreiben und im Schreiben für Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit Datenvisualisierung und ein gutes Gespür für Design

  • Erste Erfahrungen in Kommunikation oder PR (z. B. in einem Think Tank, an einer Universität, in einer NGO) oder in einem redaktionellen Umfeld bzw. einer Agentur

  • Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Teams

  • Erfahrung in der Organisation von Meetings, Veranstaltungen oder Trainings

So bewirbst Du Dich

Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung bis zum 06.12.2026 ein. ISD behält sich das Recht vor, Vorstellungsgespräche zu führen und die Stelle vor Ablauf der Frist zu besetzen. Bitte reiche deine Bewerbung ausschließlich auf Deutsch ein und gib dein Englischniveau an. Bitte gib außerdem an, ob ein Start zum 04.01.2027 für dich möglich ist.

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

Improve how we engage with leads

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

What you’ll bring

Nice to have

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive – Italy
jobs.description:
Founding Account Executive – Italy

About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Italy from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English and Italian. German is a strong plus

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Localization Production Coordinator

About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Overview

Want to help bring a world-class digital product to audiences around the globe? As a Production Coordinator on our client’s Localization team, you’ll support the localization of product features, marketing campaigns, editorial content, and web experiences across multiple markets. You’ll work alongside Senior Coordinators and Project Managers to deliver high-quality work on time, while building your expertise in localization operations and cross-functional collaboration.

This role is built to grow. The localization function is shifting toward AI-first workflows, and over the next 12 months you’ll move from supported operational work toward independently running AI-assisted localization workflows. You’ll run traditional processes while building the skills to be the human judgment layer for AI output, and you’ll take on greater cross-functional ownership along the way. We’re hiring for today’s work and for where this role is heading.

Main Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the end-to-end localization workflow for product features, marketing campaigns, editorial, and web content, with guidance from Senior Coordinators or Project Managers
  • Work with designers, product owners, engineers, marketers, and internal reviewers to gather localization requirements and track open action items
  • Collaborate with external vendors on query management, file handoffs, and delivery timelines
  • Monitor project status and flag risks or blockers to stakeholders early
  • Manage day-to-day translation operations, including testing, bug triage, localizability reviews, and design audits
  • Help prioritize and balance incoming work across shifting priorities
  • Follow established translation workflows and contribute ideas to improve efficiency and reduce time to market
  • Use AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, and look for new ways to apply them as your skills grow
  • Assist with project retrospectives, internal reports, and presentations
  • Support new team members by sharing knowledge and documenting processes
  • Partner with Project Managers and Program Managers to make sure program operations align with business needs and localization best practices

Job Requirements

Founder & CEO — AI-Native Captive in a Box

Founder & CEO — AI-Native Captive in a Box

Self-insurance for everyone. Self-insurance is no longer just for the Microsofts of the world. Give everyone the option to get cover without paying an insurance company.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

Large companies have long cut their insurance costs by setting up a captive: their own insurance company, holding capital aside to cover risks like employee injury or health, and keeping the margin when claims are low. Global captive premium is around $240bn, about a tenth of worldwide P&C. But captives are complex to set up: feasibility studies, actuarial work, legal structuring and ongoing management fees keep almost every company below the very largest out. Loss data arrives as messy spreadsheets, and UK firms have had to go offshore because there's no UK captive regime.

We are building a captive that any company can set up in days, not months. AI agents take in loss runs and policies, model the retention options and draft the feasibility study. The platform then runs the captive (reserving, board packs, filings and claims data) with qualified actuaries signing off. Fronting and reinsurance partners, starting with Aviva, carry the paper. The venture holds no balance-sheet risk: it earns a feasibility fee, then an annual platform fee per captive.

Jobs to be Done:

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Size the market. Work out which UK mid-market firms have the capital and loss profile for a captive once costs come down, and which lines of risk to start with.

  • Build the platform. Take the AI feasibility and captive management product from concept to something brokers, CFOs and regulators trust, with actuaries in the loop.

  • Line up the paper. Agree fronting and reinsurance terms with Aviva and other partners so small captives can be written.

  • Win the first captives. Land the first mid-market clients and broker partners, and be ready for the UK regime when it opens in 2027.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the default way mid-sized companies self-insure, then expand into group captives, cells, Europe and the US.

Your Ideal Experience

We are not looking for a pure actuary or a pure software founder. The ideal candidate understands how insurance works and wants to rebuild it with AI.

  • A background in financial services or insurance: commercial insurance, broking, captives, reinsurance, actuarial or risk management.

  • Somewhat technical and building with AI: you can design agentic workflows and work closely with engineers, even if you're not writing all the code.

  • B2B commercial instinct: you can sell to CFOs and brokers and navigate long, considered buying decisions.

  • Comfort with regulation: you can work with the PRA, FCA and fronting partners and turn compliance into a product feature.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

  • Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors.

This is your company. We're here to help.
