Digital CS Program Manager

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

  • Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

  • Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

  • Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

  • Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

  • Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on.

Your first year

  • First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team.

  • After 4 months: your first plays for new customers are live, each running against a control group.

  • By the end of your first year: around 8 plays are live, at least 5 of them with a proven effect, and you’ve run a first pilot with an AI agent.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business.

  • Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers.

  • A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else.

  • No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon.

  • Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently.

Nice to haves

  • You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over.

  • Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in.

  • A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry.

  • Experience in Git and pull requests

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

The successful candidate will be responsible for acquiring and developing new partnerships with resellers, system integrators, and consultancies serving federal, state, and municipal government, education, and other public institutions — while ensuring existing partnerships are nurtured and maintained. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in partner management or business development within the public sector, and a strong understanding of DACH public procurement dynamics.

  • Negotiate and close partnership agreements with potential partners, ensuring terms are favorable to both parties and compliant with public sector procurement requirements.

  • Manage existing partnerships, ensuring ongoing communication and effective collaboration to drive growth and value for both parties.

  • Stay up to date with public sector industry trends, regulatory developments (e.g., cybersecurity compliance mandates, NIS2), competitive landscapes, and market conditions to identify new opportunities.

What sets you apart:

  • Familiarity with public procurement processes and frameworks (tenders, RFPs, framework agreements) in Germany, Austria, and/or Switzerland.

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including within long, multi-stakeholder public sector sales cycles.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently, as well as part of a team.

  • Fluent in German and English, or with additional languages such as Spanish, French and Dutch being a plus.

  • Working knowledge of AI tools, capabilities, and limitations, with the ability to translate them into practical partner and customer value.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager

What we're building

Jiga is on a mission to help engineers build physical products faster.

The problem: engineers designing physical products waste weeks chasing quotes, vetting suppliers, and managing procurement instead of actually engineering. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). Think "npm install for mechanical engineers" - get the parts you need without the admin nightmare.

We're a small, fully-funded, cashflow-positive team serving enterprise customers like NASA, Google, Tesla, and Apple.

The role

We're looking for an execution-focused, zero-fluff Staff Product Manager. Someone who can take ownership and drive product initiatives with a high degree of autonomy. You'll be making calls on what we build and why, translating messy customer and operational problems into simple solutions, and making sure they're executed well, monitored, and improved over time.

How we actually work

We’re a small remote team made up of the best of the best. Our team members are distributed around the globe, with product and engineering talent across Europe, Israel, and the US. You’ll also work with teammates in Asia. Most of our work happens async, which is the secret sauce of our success.

High trust, low bullshit: We don't count hours or peek over your shoulder on Slack. We trust you to get your work done and tell us when something's wrong. You'll have real ownership over what you build, no process theater, no busy-work meetings.

Question everything: See something that doesn't make sense? Say it. Have a better way to do something? Just do it. We actually mean it when we say we want people to challenge the status quo and improve things. Our internal motto is “Don’t drink the kool-aid.”

No busy work, no fluff: We keep processes lightweight and practical. If something helps us work better or solve a real problem, we do it. If it creates work without adding value, we question it.

Actually friendly, not corporate friendly: We play games online every week (current favorite: Make it Meme). Once a year we fly everyone somewhere beautiful for our offsite. We genuinely like hanging out together, which turns out to be way better than forced "team building exercises."

What we value in product and engineering:

Simple > Complicated. Simple code, simple architecture. Simple solutions are better than complex ones.

Ship it, then improve it. Perfection is the enemy of done. Launch now, iterate forever.

Product > Engineering. Every line of code should make our users' lives better. We're not here to show off our algorithmic prowess - we're here to solve real business problems.

Financials

Jiga is fully funded, cashflow positive, with growing revenue MoM. We're completely transparent about our runway and finances - ask us anything.

What you'll actually do

  • Talk to customers and suppliers, and work closely with internal users to understand their workflows and pain points (not just read reports about them).

  • Go deep into a complex problem and come back with a simple solution.

  • Analyze and monitor product usage data yourself to inform decisions and measure results.

  • Define what we build next and why, then write specs engineers can actually execute on.

  • Work closely with engineering and design to take solutions through delivery, follow up after launch, and improve what isn’t working.

  • Collaborate with sales, CS, and operations to understand business needs and improve internal processes.

  • Take ownership and move things forward independently without exhausting approval loops.

  • Clearly communicate what we’re not focusing on and why.

  • Use AI throughout all of the above to move faster, go deeper, and get more done.

What we're looking for

Must have:

  • You've built meaningful products that people use and that drive business results.

  • 5+ years in product, including experience owning complex initiatives independently.

  • Startup experience (<50 people). You know what “do everything” means.

  • Actually hands-on: you've done user research, written specs, built prototypes, and prioritized backlogs yourself. Recently. Not five years ago before you “moved to strategy.”

  • Comfortable with data, dashboards, and product analytics. You ask the right questions, find the answers yourself, and question what the numbers are telling you.

  • You know what moves the needle, focus on that, and separate real problems from noise.

  • You go deep with engineers, communicate clearly in writing, keep stakeholders aligned, and ask users questions that uncover real needs.

  • You're willing and able to get into operational details, work with internal teams, and improve how things get done.

  • You use AI hands-on in your daily work and have experience building AI-powered features that deliver real value within users’ workflows.

  • Strong UI/UX instincts. You have opinions about the details.

  • At least 4 hours of overlap with GMT+3 working hours.

Nice to have:

  • A background in industrial design, mechanical engineering, or supply chain.

  • Hands-on experience as a software engineer, data analyst, or UI/UX designer.

  • B2B experience in collaboration tools, quoting, supply chain, manufacturing, CAD, logistics, or marketplaces.

You'll love it here if

  • You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. "Figure it out" sounds like freedom, not abandonment.

  • You have strong opinions loosely held. You're decisive but update quickly when you're wrong.

  • You're low-ego, high-output. You do the grunt work, not just the strategy decks.

  • You see gaps and fill them without being asked.

  • You say what you think. No corporate speak, no hedging, no "let's circle back."

  • "If I can solve this without pulling in a dev, I'll just do it" is how you operate.

  • You're obsessively curious about manufacturing and how things get made.

This might not be for you if

  • You need meetings to get things moving.

  • You prefer clear requirements handed to you.

  • You like building consensus before making any decision.

  • "Move fast and break things" gives you anxiety.

  • You want to focus on "strategy" and have someone else handle the details.

  • You can’t operate without a clear process and hierarchy.

What we offer

  • A small team where you matter: We never compromise on people. That means you are part of the best team in the world.

  • Zero bureaucracy: We hate process theatre as much as you do.

  • Real ownership and responsibility: Make decisions, ship solutions, own the outcomes.

  • Complete flexibility: Work from anywhere, set your own hours, take time off when you need it (parents especially welcome).

  • Genuinely high trust: We trust you to do great work and be honest when things go sideways.

  • A team that actually likes each other: International, diverse, genuinely friendly people who enjoy working together.

  • Generous stock options: Meaningful equity in the company you’re helping build.

  • Self-development budget for books, courses, conferences, whatever helps you grow.

  • Annual offsites in beautiful places.

  • Fast-paced environment with tons of creative freedom.

  • Hard, interesting problems with a team that's positioned to win big.

How to apply

Tell us about a product decision you made that was controversial at the time but turned out right. And one that turned out wrong.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Manager

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a dedicated Account Manager to own and accelerate expansion across our existing customer base. This is a high-impact, commercial role for someone who thrives on closing six- to seven-figure deals with enterprise teams.


We've grown fast without dedicated expansion resources, but the opportunity is massive. Our team has identified millions of dollars in qualified pipeline, and we need a closer who can convert it.

You'll own a book of business worth $2M+ ARR across high-growth mid-market and enterprise companies (~400-8,000 employees), managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through close. You'll be measured on Net Revenue Retention and your ability to execute consultative, value-based selling at scale.

Important to know:

  • Hours: This is an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening.

  • Working location: Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (Borough). Most people do 5.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own and execute complex expansion and renewal cycles across a $2M+ book of mid-market and enterprise accounts, managing deals from six- to seven figures with technical, multi-stakeholder buying groups.

  • Drive Net Revenue Retention by proactively identifying expansion opportunities, negotiating renewals, and preventing churn across your portfolio. You'll be commercially accountable for growing the revenue in your book.

  • Execute consultative, value-based selling by deeply understanding each customer's RevOps challenges, articulating clear ROI, and positioning Kernel as mission-critical infrastructure for their CRM data strategy.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership to shape our expansion strategy, feed critical customer insights into the product roadmap, and help define our enterprise selling motion.

  • Navigate complex contracts, security reviews, and legal discussions independently, moving deals forward without constant support from leadership or legal.

More specifically, you will be:

  • Speaking the language of RevOps professionals, discussing CRM hierarchies, data hygiene, territory planning, and the technical challenges of managing company data at scale.

  • Becoming the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product, translating technical capabilities into clear business value for VP-level stakeholders.

  • Running data-driven account reviews and strategic planning sessions to prioritize where to invest your time for maximum revenue impact.

What You Bring

  • Proven track record of expansion and renewal excellence: 4-7 years of B2B SaaS sales or account management experience, with at least 2 years consistently closing $100k+ deals per year and managing a book of business worth $2M+ ARR.

  • Demonstrable commercial performance: You have a track record of consistently overachieving on Net Revenue Retention or expansion targets (130%+ NRR is the bar), with specific examples of closing significant expansions from existing customers. You're commercially driven and performance-oriented, motivated by hitting and exceeding revenue targets, and you understand the levers that drive expansion and renewal.

  • Enterprise sales expertise: Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with technical buyers. You know how to manage 6-12 month sales cycles, build consensus across buying committees, and close six-figure deals.

  • Consultative selling and communication skills: You can execute value-based, solutions-oriented selling, asking great questions to uncover true business pain and positioning product capabilities as strategic solutions rather than features. You have excellent verbal and written communication skills - you articulate complex ideas crisply, write compelling proposals and business cases, and present confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency: Comfortable discussing technical concepts with RevOps and data teams. You can translate complex requirements into product demonstrations and articulate technical value to non-technical executives.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in ambiguity and are energized by building processes from scratch. You're a generalist who can wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your job description, and move fast without perfect clarity.

  • Operational independence: You can navigate contracts, negotiate terms, handle security questionnaires, and move deals through legal and procurement without needing constant support from leadership.

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Background in data infrastructure, CRM platforms, or API-first products.

  • Startup or scale-up experience (Series A-C), where you've seen a commercial function built from the ground up.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Struggle with technical stakeholders: Our customers are RevOps professionals who speak CRM, data models, and API integrations. If you're not comfortable learning and discussing technical concepts, you won't be able to build credibility.

  • Expect consistent 9-5 hours: With West Coast customers and the intensity of a fast-growing startup, this role requires flexibility and often long hours. If work-life balance is your top priority, this isn't the right fit.

  • Haven't consistently hit commercial targets: If you don't have a track record of meeting or exceeding expansion and renewal quotas, or if you've never managed a significant book of business, you'll struggle with the commercial accountability this role requires.

  • Prefer individual contributor work without cross-functional collaboration: This role requires constant coordination with Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. If you prefer to work in isolation, this won't be a good fit.

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass
jobs.description:
Technical Account Manager (AI Driven) - Curveglass

Curveglass is a startup incubated by AE Studio that provides a flight-level correction layer for airline revenue management, helping airlines make better decisions through advanced data science and modeling.
As part of the AE Studio ecosystem, Curveglass combines the speed, focus, and ownership of a startup with access to a broader network of engineering, AI, and product expertise.
Curveglass runs directly inside each airline's cloud environment. Our product consists of a common Core and a client-specific Adapter, which handles everything needed to make Curveglass work within each airline's environment — including the web application, APIs, data integrations, business rules, and exports into the airline's systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Account Manager at Curveglass, you'll own the technical implementation of Curveglass for airline clients end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role with broad ownership. You'll build and maintain client-specific Adapter code, work across frontend and backend systems, integrate with airline data and infrastructure, and deploy and operate Curveglass within client cloud environments.
You'll also work directly with clients. That means understanding their technical and business needs, participating in and leading meetings, troubleshooting issues, analyzing recommendation results in collaboration with revenue management teams, and managing technical expectations as needed.
You'll work closely with the Curveglass core team to determine what should be solved within a client's Adapter and what should become part of the shared Core. You'll bring client needs back to the team as roadmap input and Core change requests, while owning the implementation of client-specific functionality yourself.
We're looking for someone who enjoys the full lifecycle of software engineering: understanding the problem, building the solution, deploying it, and seeing how it performs in the real world.
You'll have meaningful ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence Curveglass's architecture and product as we grow.
If you enjoy owning technical problems end-to-end and working closely with the people using what you build, we'd love to talk.

ABOUT YOU

You're a strong, pragmatic engineer who enjoys owning systems beyond just writing the code.
You're comfortable working across different parts of the stack and taking responsibility for an implementation from beginning to end: understanding requirements, designing the solution, building integrations and product functionality, deploying infrastructure, troubleshooting issues, and continuing to improve the system once it's live.
You're comfortable operating in a startup environment where problems may not always come neatly defined. You can take ownership, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and move from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production solution.
You also communicate well with people outside of engineering. You can understand the business context behind a technical request, explain technical decisions clearly, and lead conversations with clients when needed.
You work well independently, collaborate closely with data science and product teams, and care about building software that is reliable, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong software engineering experience: You can independently design, build, debug, and maintain production systems.
  • Fluency in Python: You're highly proficient with Python and comfortable using it in production environments.
  • Full-stack development: You're comfortable working with TypeScript and React and can own frontend functionality when needed.
  • SQL and data integration: You can work confidently with relational data, APIs, client datasets, and production data flows.
  • Cloud infrastructure: You're comfortable deploying and maintaining applications in AWS or Azure.
  • Containers and infrastructure as code: You have hands-on experience with containers and tools such as Terraform.
  • End-to-end ownership: You're comfortable taking responsibility for a system across application code, integrations, infrastructure, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Client-facing communication: You're comfortable interacting directly with clients, leading technical meetings when needed, explaining decisions clearly, managing expectations, and pushing back thoughtfully when appropriate.
  • Business thinking: You care about why something is being built and the outcome it needs to create, not just the technical implementation.
  • Production-minded development: You write maintainable code and care about reliability, observability, debugging, and how systems behave in real-world environments.
  • AI-powered development: You use modern AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and know how to use them effectively without sacrificing quality.
  • Self-management: You can take ownership of complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and deliver without constant oversight.
  • Effective communication in English: You're fluent in spoken and written English and can confidently communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Timezone flexibility: You're comfortable occasionally adapting meeting hours to work with clients across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.

Bonus Points for

  • Enterprise implementation experience: You've implemented enterprise or data products where customers require meaningful integration and customization rather than a purely self-service SaaS product.
  • Airline or revenue management experience: Familiarity with airline pricing, forecasting, revenue management, or related systems.
  • Data engineering experience: You've worked with production data pipelines and technologies such as Parquet, Snowflake, or similar data infrastructure.
  • Spanish or Portuguese: Professional proficiency in either language.
  • Startup experience: You thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy ambiguity, and are comfortable taking ownership beyond a narrowly defined job description.
  • Cloud deployment experience: You've deployed and operated applications or infrastructure within enterprise AWS or Azure environments.
  • Strong product instincts: You understand when something should be solved as client-specific functionality versus becoming part of a broader product.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Startup environment, backed by AE Studio: Join a focused, fast-moving startup while benefiting from the broader engineering, AI, and product ecosystem of AE Studio.
  • High-impact engineering: Build production systems that directly shape the Curveglass product and how airlines use it.
  • End-to-end responsibility: Own your work from architecture and implementation through deployment, integration, and ongoing operation.
  • Real-world problems: Work on complex engineering and data problems within airline revenue management, where the software you build directly supports business decisions.
  • Direct product exposure: Work closely with the people using what you build and bring those insights back into technical and product decisions.
  • Product influence: Help shape Curveglass's architecture, roadmap, and approach to client-specific versus shared product functionality.
  • Small, collaborative team: Work closely with engineering, data science, product, and leadership, with significant autonomy over how you solve problems.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, or connect with the broader AE Studio team and community.
  • Flexible schedules: We care about outcomes, ownership, and impact—not micromanagement.
  • Competitive compensation: Competitive pay and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
  • Opportunities for growth: Help shape how Curveglass approaches engineering, infrastructure, integrations, and technical decision-making as we scale.

jobs.title: Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol
jobs.description:
Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol

Founder & CEO — Group Buying Agent Protocol

Our AI agents are already saving us money, but they are leaving savings on the table. Build the protocol that lets AI agents pool their users and negotiate as one, starting with insurance.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

People and businesses are starting to hand their buying to AI agents. The share of UK adults who have used or would use an AI agent to shop rose from 31% to 48% in a year. But every agent still shops alone: it gets a quote for one person, one business, one policy at a time.

A careful, low-risk customer looks the same as any other request, and intermediaries take a big cut. Insurance brokers earned about $180bn in fees and commissions worldwide in 2024.

We are building the layer that lets agents buy together. Any agent can enrol its user, with consented and verified data, into cohorts that share a profile: for example small businesses with a clean claims record, or EV owners with a garage and a home charger. Suppliers bid for the cohort in set windows, and each member still gets an individual price.

We start with insurance, where verified data changes the price most, and where the best cohorts can eventually share in their own risk through a profit-share pool or group captive. Then we take the same rails to any category where pooled demand gets a better deal: energy, software, procurement.

The timing is right. The FCA's Mills Review expects AI to act for consumers "within agreed parameters". The Data (Use and Access) Act created powers for smart data schemes, so agents can bring verified facts to every quote. And general-purpose agents are launching at scale.

Jobs to be Done:

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Pick the first market. Decide where group buying works first: SMEs and mid-sized businesses, or consumers through their agents, and which product line to start with.

  • Build the rails. Design the protocol and infrastructure that lets any AI agent enrol users, share verified data with consent and join a cohort.

  • Prove the price. Run the first pilot cohorts with Aviva and show that verified, pooled demand earns a better price than shopping alone.

  • Win the agents. Get agent builders and platforms to plug in, so demand flows to you rather than to comparison sites.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and extend the rails beyond insurance to any category where buying together wins.

Your Ideal Experience:

You don't need an insurance background. We're looking for an AI-native builder who wants to build the infrastructure the agent economy runs on.

  • Founder or early technical or product leader who has built infrastructure, APIs, protocols or marketplaces.

  • Deep, hands-on fluency with AI agents: you build with them every day and have strong views on where agentic commerce is going.

  • Platform and partnership instinct: you know how to get developers and other platforms to adopt your rails.

  • Exposure to fintech, insurtech, marketplaces or procurement is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: defining a category that doesn't exist yet and making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

  • Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors.

Most importantly, you believe agents will soon buy most things for us, and you want to build the layer that makes them buy better.

This is your company. We're here to help.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

You will be expected to remain deeply hands-on with the tools and systems behind our growth engine. We want to build a small, highly leveraged growth team where technology replaces repetitive work and allows us to experiment faster and operate at greater scale.

You will report directly to the VP of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build systems to identify target accounts and buying signals, enrich them with relevant data, and turn them into actionable growth opportunities

  • Design and execute highly targeted outbound and account-based campaigns across channels, using AI and automation to operate at scale without sacrificing relevance

  • Build workflows and agents for research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis

  • Develop a high-velocity experimentation engine: identify new audiences, messages, channels and tactics, launch tests quickly, measure their impact and scale what works

Solutions Consultant

About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly technical and customer-oriented Solutions Consultant to join our growing team.

As a Solutions Consultant, you will sit at the intersection of Sales, Product, Engineering and our customers. You will work with financial institutions to understand complex compliance challenges, design solutions using Dotfile’s platform and AI agents, and turn them into successful production deployments.

You will own the technical customer journey from pre-sales through implementation: leading discovery, designing solution architectures, delivering compelling demonstrations and proofs of concept, and guiding customers through integration and go-live. As Dotfile moves toward increasingly autonomous compliance, you will help customers rethink manual processes, identify opportunities for automation, and deploy our AI capabilities into real-world compliance workflows.

jobs.title: Responsable De La Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech – Cdi
jobs.description:
Responsable De La Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech – Cdi

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, la Direction de la Recherche, du Doctorat, de l’Innovation et de l’Entrepreneuriat (DRDIE) définit et porte la stratégie scientifique, d’innovation et d’entrepreneuriat de l’école. Elle coordonne les moyens nécessaires à sa mise en œuvre, de la recherche amont à sa valorisation en innovations pour les filières industrielles, veille à leur adéquation avec les ambitions fixées et s’assure de la bonne exécution par les centres, qui contribuent à la dynamique collective.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité de Responsable de la Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech, et sous la responsabilité du Directeur Adjoint Recherche, Doctorat, Innovation & Entrepreneuriat, vous portez l’offre de valorisation de technologies et d’entrepreneuriat deeptech de l’école. Vos principales missions consisteront à :

·         développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser issues des résultats de recherche des centres et des partenaires ;

·         convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création ;

·         promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech » ;

·         former et accompagner les personnels de recherche dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations, les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique et les étudiants dans le domaine de l’innovation, dans le cadre de leur formation initiale.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser

·         structurer et piloter l’activité : analyse tactique, définition du process et des outils, actions opérationnelles, suivi de la performance, animation d’un réseau d’experts et mesure de la satisfaction ;

·         organiser et professionnaliser l’« Innovathon », dispositif de valorisation de la recherche à destination des filières industrielles, hybridé avec la formation à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         alimenter le catalogue de technologies à potentiel issues des centres et des partenaires de l’écosystème : construire le modèle, identifier et mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes, assurer le sourcing des résultats de la recherche, caractériser leur potentiel et proposer le mode de valorisation le plus pertinent.

Convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création

·         structurer et piloter cette activité de transfert selon la même démarche (process, outils, suivi de la performance, réseau d’experts, satisfaction) ;

·         développer les dispositifs de prospection auprès des clients industriels pour le transfert des technologies du portefeuille ;

·         identifier et activer les sources de financement utiles à l’activité ;

·         initier des projets de (pré)maturation de ces technologies, ou de transfert vers des candidats à la (pré)incubation et vers les industriels.

Promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech »

·         mobiliser les réseaux institutionnels, académiques et industriels afin de recruter des candidats aux parcours de (pré)incubation, de repérer des technologies à valoriser et d’identifier des prospects industriels ;

·         concevoir et organiser les événements annuels dédiés à la valorisation, à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         organiser les animations de l’« Espace Start-Up Territorial ».

Accompagner les personnels de recherche, selon leur maturité, dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations

·         sensibiliser les personnels de recherche à la valorisation et à l’entrepreneuriat, avec une attention particulière pour les doctorants et post-doctorants ; coordonner les dispositifs internes dédiés ainsi que la participation aux dispositifs de l’écosystème ;

·         organiser, en coordination avec RED, un parcours valorisant et incitatif de sensibilisation, de formation et de détection dédié aux doctorants ;

·         identifier et « recruter » les chercheurs-valorisateurs (doctorants, personnels temporaires de recherche, personnels permanents) pour des projets de valorisation ou d’incubation ;

·         déployer des actions de mise en visibilité des chercheurs-valorisateurs.

Accompagner les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique

·         opérer l’un des deux parcours étudiant-entrepreneur du programme de pré-incubation et proposer des pistes d’amélioration ou de complément ;

·         accompagner les incubés, selon leur maturité, avec un focus fort sur la définition et la validation du besoin des cibles identifiées, de la proposition de valeur et du marché applicatif, sur le design fonctionnel de la solution et sur la consolidation de l’équipe porteuse du projet de création ;

·         les accompagner dans le montage de collaborations avec les centres et dans la recherche de financements.

Piloter le module de sensibilisation à l’innovation « Dynamiques d’innovation et entrepreneuriat » (IFIE1)

·         concevoir la maquette pédagogique et coordonner son déploiement ;

·         ancrer le module dans le continuum innovation & entrepreneuriat, dans une perspective de recrutement pour le parcours étudiant-entrepreneur.

 

Le poste nécessite des déplacements de courte durée, ainsi que l’organisation ou la participation à des événements en soirée.

 

CAPACITÉ ET ATTITUDES :

·         Vous disposez des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes :

o    maîtrise des approches et postures d’accompagnement dans le domaine de l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    approches structurantes de créativité et de conception innovante centrée utilisateurs ; approches de résolution de problèmes ;

o    méthodologies et outils de gestion de projets de recherche ou d’innovation ;

o    connaissance de l’écosystème institutionnel et académique de la recherche, de l’innovation et de la création d’entreprise ;

o    maîtrise des financements publics et privés dédiés à la valorisation de la recherche et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    maîtrise des processus de création et de développement d’une start-up, et bonne connaissance du processus de création d’une offre produit ; approche processus ;

o    capacité à déployer une approche d’accompagnement en entrepreneuriat, à commercialiser une offre B2B, à construire et développer un portefeuille de produits et à élaborer un plan de promotion de l’activité ;

o    capacité à déployer une méthode de créativité structurante, à analyser ou élaborer une roadmap produit et à mobiliser les réseaux ;

o    capacité à évaluer et hiérarchiser les besoins pour maîtriser la charge d’activité, et à gérer les aléas ;

o    aisance dans les échanges en anglais.

·         Les caractéristiques suivantes vous ressemblent :

o    organisation dans la conduite de votre activité et capacité à rendre compte de façon différenciée et adaptée à la situation ;

o    force de proposition et prise d’initiative ;

o    posture d’accompagnant adaptée au niveau de maturité du bénéficiaire ;

o    capacité de compréhension et d’influence d’écosystèmes complexes ;

o    aptitude à analyser des objets technologiques dans une perspective applicative, en réponse à un besoin utilisateur ;

o    adaptabilité aux différents interlocuteurs et situations dans un écosystème interculturel, politique et complexe ;

o    méthode, rigueur et fiabilité d’exécution.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·         Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master II et bénéficiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la recherche et de l’innovation.[1]

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

  • le télétravail possible ;

  • une restauration administrative sur place ;

  • une aide à la mobilité durable pour les trajets domicile-travail ;

  • une action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) ;

  • une aide au déménagement ;

  • une aide à l’intégration sur le territoire : https://www.grand-albigeois.fr/entreprendre/creer-se-developper/soutien-au-recrutement-salarie/

 

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

·       Nature et durée du contrat : CDI

·       Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et aux personnes contractuelles

  • Fourchette de rémunération proposée de 31 700 € brut annuel à 37 600 € brut annuel, selon le profil.

    La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d’emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom.

 

  • À usage interne :

    Catégorie du poste et métier de référence :  Catégorie II, Métier G – Cadre Administratif et de Gestion

Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description:
Senior Engineering Team Lead

WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. 

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

Engineering:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows.

  • Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development.

  • Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery.

  • Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off);

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years;

  • Profit-sharing scheme

  • Healthcare plan with excellent coverage;

  • Lunch Vouchers;

  • Mental Health support;

  • Flexible remote working policy;

  • Regular team-life event / activity;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition,

  • Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, 

  • A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. 

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Senior Software Engineer- IAM & Billing (m/f/d)

At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis

· Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack

Your Role💻

As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required.

For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond.

Your Tasks

  • Design and build Python services for IAM, consumption tracking and billing on OPCP, using AI agents across the full development lifecycle.

  • Own your services end to end, from the first design sketch to production on Kubernetes, and share on-call with the squad.

  • Shape the squad's agentic engineering practice: agent workflows, context and guardrails, review standards for AI-generated code, and how we measure the impact.

  • Design our REST APIs so they can evolve without breaking the teams and customers who depend on them.

  • Build authentication and authorization flows on OAuth2/OIDC.

  • Make asynchronous, distributed workflows reliable: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures.

  • Drive technical design in the squad: make architecture calls, document key decisions and review your teammates' designs and code.

  • Mentor other engineers and help the squad raise its engineering bar, including how it builds with AI agents.

What we offer you💼

  • Real influence on the architecture of a sovereign cloud platform at an early, formative stage – a platform in build mode with strong ownership.

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling and room to push our engineering practices further.

About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Logistics
jobs.description:
Data Analyst - Logistics

Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.

Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data.

What you get 

  • A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. 

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. 

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. 

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. 

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. 

  • Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. 

About us 

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. 

 
What the job looks like 

  • Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.

  • Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.

  • Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.

  • Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.

  • Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.


What you bring 

  • Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.

  • Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.

  • Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.

  • Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.

  • AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.

  • Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.

  • Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

 
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.
