Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder

Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 10x YoY.

  • Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets

jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.description:
Assistant Controller

About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI is looking for an Assistant Controller to lead our group accounting and financial reporting function from London. Reporting to the Global Controller, you will own the US GAAP close and consolidation, lead group financial reporting and the day-to-day delivery of our Big Four group audit, and oversee statutory accounting across our international entities.

You will directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close enough to the detail to resolve issues and set a high bar for accuracy, while also developing the team, strengthening controls and improving how we close, report and operate.

Your initial mandate is focused on group and statutory accounting. Cash and treasury operations and payroll will initially remain outside your remit. Once the core accounting mandate is firmly established, we expect the role to broaden over time to include greater oversight of cash and treasury. We are therefore looking for someone who already brings meaningful experience in these areas.

You will work closely with the Global Controller on complex accounting matters, systems and automation, controls and the continued development of the function. MUBI's accounting environment spans subscription streaming, film distribution and production across multiple entities, countries and currencies. We are looking for someone who learned the fundamentals in Big Four audit and has since applied them in-house, with the judgement and experience to operate effectively across this complexity as the business continues to grow.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Own the close and consolidation. Lead the month-, quarter- and year-end close and consolidation process across all entities, including review of journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, eliminations and other key close outputs.

  • Lead financial reporting. Prepare and review consolidated US GAAP financial statements, management reporting packs and supporting schedules, ensuring group reporting is accurate, timely and well supported.

  • Own key accounting areas. Oversee accounting for content assets, subscription and distribution revenue, deferred revenue, partner and app-store settlements, intercompany balances and foreign currency. Work with FP&A, content and other teams where accounting depends on operational data or business context.

  • Oversee global statutory accounting. Directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads and coordinate statutory reporting across the group, working with local teams and external advisers to ensure statutory accounts and filings are complete, accurate and delivered on time.

  • Lead the audit. Manage the day-to-day delivery of the Big Four group audit and coordinate statutory audits across our entities. Build an effective relationship with our auditors and advisers and ensure requests and deliverables are well supported and resolved promptly.

  • Strengthen controls and processes. Document and improve accounting processes and SOPs, strengthen key close and reporting controls, and help develop the control environment toward public-company and SOX standards.

  • Partner on technical accounting. Work with the Global Controller and external advisers on new or complex accounting matters, helping translate technical conclusions into clear accounting policies and treatment.

  • Improve systems and automation. Lead improvements to our accounting systems, close and reporting workflows. Use automation and AI where they can materially improve accuracy, speed and efficiency.

What you’ll bring:

  • Active US CPA licence. You hold an active US CPA licence and bring strong practical knowledge of US GAAP.

  • Big Four and in-house experience. You have at least eight years of accounting experience, including meaningful Big Four audit experience and at least two years in an in-house accounting role, ideally within a complex, multi-entity international business.

  • Close and consolidation expertise. You have owned or played a senior role in month-, quarter- and year-end close and group consolidation, including the preparation or review of financial statements, with a strong understanding of the GL and end-to-end financial reporting process.

  • Strong people leadership. You have at least three years of experience managing and developing accounting professionals and are comfortable leading experienced team members across different countries and areas of responsibility.

  • Audit and controls experience. You have acted as a senior company-side contact for external auditors and have experience documenting, operating and improving internal financial controls.

  • International statutory experience. You have overseen statutory accounting and reporting across multiple jurisdictions and know how to work effectively with local finance teams, advisers and auditors without needing to be the technical expert in every market.

  • Meaningful cash and treasury experience. You have practical experience with the core disciplines of cash and treasury in a multi-entity business, including cash reporting or forecasting, banking operations, payment controls and bank reconciliations.

  • Strong systems and process capability. You have experience with NetSuite, Ramp and other finance and accounting systems, plus advanced Excel skills.

  • Clear judgement and communication. You have strong attention to detail, can move comfortably between accounting detail and the wider business context, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and manage competing priorities under tight deadlines.

  • You have the right to work in the UK and are able to work in person from our London office.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Account Executive (AE) to join our Sales Team. The ideal candidate has experience selling to the financial services industry, a strong understanding of AML, KYC/B, or Risk Management, and a track record of working with a proven sales playbook.

As one of the early sales hires, you will play a key role in shaping our go-to-market (GTM) strategy while actively engaging, nurturing, and closing opportunities across the EMEA region and beyond.

The position is based in Paris or London.

Key Responsibilities

About you

jobs.title: Stage de recherche : la place des SHS dans la recherche en école d’ingénieurs
jobs.description:
Stage de recherche : la place des SHS dans la recherche en école d’ingénieurs

Unité : Département Management International, IMT Nord Europe ; IMT Business School, Evry

Responsable hiérarchique : Clément Séhier, Jean-Luc Moriceau

Responsable fonctionnel : Clément Séhier, Jean-Luc Moriceau

Catégorie : Stagiaire (Master 1 ou Master 2)

Nature de l’emploi : Stage de recherche

Lieu de travail : IMT Nord Europe, campus de Villeneuve d’Ascq, ou IMT Business School, campus d’Évry

Contexte :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Le stage est à pourvoir au sein du Département Management International d’IMT Nord Europe (campus de Villeneuve d’Ascq) ou à IMT Business School (campus d’Évry), en lien avec les enseignants-chercheurs en SHS du groupe IMT et avec la direction scientifique de l’IMT.

Missions :

Les écoles d’ingénieurs sont encouragées à développer des projets de recherche interdisciplinaires pour aborder des questions complexes, notamment celles liées aux transitions numériques, industrielles et socio-écologiques. Le stage porte sur la place des sciences humaines et sociales (SHS) dans la recherche en école d’ingénieurs, à travers une réflexion à la fois théorique et empirique sur l’ensemble des écoles de l’IMT.

Il s’agit non seulement de recenser des dispositifs, mais aussi d’interroger les conceptions de la recherche interdisciplinaire qu’ils traduisent, les conditions de leur développement et la place qu’y occupent les différentes disciplines et méthodes. Le stage contribuera à structurer les échanges entre les enseignants-chercheurs en SHS du groupe, à nourrir les réflexions de la direction scientifique et à éclairer la préparation du prochain plan stratégique (horizon 2028).

Activités :

  •        Cartographier les compétences en SHS dans les écoles de l’IMT (chercheurs et chercheuses, disciplines, objets de recherche, méthodes), selon un périmètre défini avec l’encadrement.

  •        Recenser les formes de collaboration interdisciplinaire impliquant des SHS (structures ou collectifs de recherche, autres dispositifs de coopération).

  •        Analyser ces expériences : définition des questions de recherche, place des disciplines, méthodes, organisation du travail collectif, difficultés rencontrées et apports.

  •        Comparer les pratiques du groupe IMT avec celles d’autres écoles d’ingénieurs.

  •        Faire émerger des thématiques propices à l’interdisciplinarité, en particulier autour des transitions socio-écologiques.

  •        Interroger les modes d’évaluation et de suivi de la recherche interdisciplinaire, et les relier à l’enseignement des SHS en école d’ingénieurs.

  •        Mener une analyse documentaire et des entretiens semi-directifs avec des chercheurs (déplacements à prévoir entre plusieurs écoles du groupe).

  •        Produire les livrables : cartographie, rapport et note de propositions ; restitution orale.


Profil du candidat/de la candidate : (Prérequis/ Diplôme) : étudiant·e de Master 1 ou 2 en SHS, LEA ou sciences de l’éducation.

 

Savoir-être

  •        Autonomie et rigueur

  •        Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs de disciplines différentes

  •        Appétence pour la recherche théorique comme pour l’enquête qualitative

Savoir faire

  •        Conduire des entretiens semi-directifs

  •        Analyser des matériaux variés

  •        Restituer les résultats de manière claire (rapport, note, présentation orale)

Connaissances

  •        Intérêt pour les relations entre sciences, techniques et société

  •        Interdisciplinarité, enseignement supérieur

  •        Transitions socio-écologiques

Conditions :

Le stage est à pourvoir entre février et août 2027, pour une durée de 4 à 5 mois (stage de Master 1 ou 2). Les dates précises seront définies avec l’encadrement.

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

 

  •        Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à Clément Séhier, Département Management International ----- ou à Jean-Luc Moriceau -----  

  •        Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines :        Par ailleurs, le poste peut être aménagé pour une personne en situation de handicap.

Date limite de candidature : 31/12/2026

jobs.description:
AI Deployment Manager, Enterprise

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Design and drive AI Agent adoption roadmaps for each customer, sequencing automation rollout to support change management and prove value at each stage.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and communicating the business impact of AI adoption in clear, compelling terms.

  • Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and cross-functional accountability throughout the onboarding process.

  • Manage integrations with the customer's ecommerce tech stack; explore feasibility of custom integration paths and troubleshoot proactively using available technical resources and AI tools.

  • Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting and workback schedules, ensuring effective project management throughout the implementation.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI Agent, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly. Proactively uses tools like Claude to improve your own efficiency.

  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

  • Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption, and mitigating churn.

  • Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth. You stay current on Gorgias product developments and ecommerce trends, and you actively contribute to team knowledge.

  • French Bilingual (C1) is a must

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

Software Engineer | Mid-Office | Python

BlockTech is hiring a Software Engineer to join its Mid-Office team in Amsterdam.

Positions, PnL, and hedging all run through Mid-Office. When a number our traders or risk team rely on is wrong, this is where it gets found and fixed.

In this role, you'll build and run that platform, and you'll be the one who follows a wrong number until you know why.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

The Mid-Office team owns the systems that keep positions, PnL, and hedging correct across every venue we trade. We work in Python, with Grafana and PostgreSQL alongside.

What will you do?

You will build and own the systems that keep our books and data accurate, including the quantitative work behind them. You'll be responsible for spotting discrepancies, investigating unexpected numbers, and tracing issues to their root cause.

You will:

  • Own the books. Maintain and evolve our position, trade, and PnL systems so they stay accurate across every venue.

  • Do the quant work. Build and refine our hedging, Greeks, margin models, and early exercise premium calculations.

  • Surface the risk. Build the risk views and calculations that show traders and the risk team what exposure we're carrying.

  • Support the desk. Work side by side with traders and researchers, and make sure the data they rely on is correct and available.

  • Deliver reporting. Provide the data internal stakeholders and regulators need: PnL breakdowns, trade surveillance, treasury accounting, and compliance.

  • Own it in production. Spot discrepancies in live data, trace the root cause, and maintain what you ship.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • You'll need to be an engineer at heart, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine passion for building and improving systems.

  • A relevant educational background, ideally in a quantitative field such as mathematics, econometrics, or computer science.

  • Professional experience with Python, Grafana, and PostgreSQL.

  • Strong debugging skills. You can trace problems to their source, even in unfamiliar systems.

  • A critical mind that follows problems through to completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in finance, ideally trading, on the systems behind positions, PnL, risk, and hedging.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% tax ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

You'll be challenged and stretched in this role, with plenty of room to grow within and beyond your main responsibilities. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to own the numbers the desk trades on?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
System Architect

About Invisix

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.

We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role

We're looking for a System Architect to decide what our metrology equipment is and why it's built that way: concept choices, system decomposition, budget allocations and the technology roadmap amongst others.

Reporting to our CTO, you look two to five years ahead and beyond, and shape our product line across several generations, so that what we build today still makes sense for our customers tomorrow. You work with our customers' technology roadmaps, marketing, the heads of R&D, our function architects and customer support, and you lead through persuasion rather than formal authority. Our system engineer builds on your concept and makes the current program work to spec. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of our metrology product line, looking two to five years ahead and beyond, across several product generations

  • Make and justify the key concept choices, weighing physics, performance, cost and risk

  • Decompose the system into modules and interfaces, and allocate the key budgets, such as throughput, cost of goods, availability and performance

  • Translate our customers' technology roadmaps and future needs into product requirements, together with marketing and customers

  • Define our platform and reuse strategy, and decide which technologies we invest in

  • Align the heads of R&D and our function architects behind the architecture, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as representing Invisix in technical discussions with customers and partners

Is this you?

  • MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, electrical or mechanical engineering or a related field, with at least 10 years of experience developing complex high-tech equipment, including a role as system or product architect

  • Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment, ideally with a product that made it to customers

  • Strong physics depth, in optics or measurement physics, so you can judge concept choices on their physical merits

  • Experience making architecture trade-offs across mechanics, electronics, optics and software, and setting system budgets for performance, throughput and cost

  • A preference for breadth over depth, comfort with ambiguity, the ability to make sound decisions on incomplete data, and the skill to persuade without formal authority

  • Active use of AI tooling in your daily work (concept studies, trade-off analysis, documentation) to boost efficiency

Nice to have

  • Experience working with the technology roadmaps of leading semiconductor manufacturers

  • Experience defining a product platform or reuse strategy across several generations

  • Experience balancing cost of goods and cost of service against performance

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up

What We Offer

  • A role at the heart of Invisix's product, shaping what our metrology equipment will be over several generations

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including an Employee Share Ownership Plan

  • A learning and development budget to support your growth

  • Flexible working arrangements, and room to grow into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales

Interested?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd like to hear from you, even if you only recognize yourself in part of this description. Submit your resume, and let's find out together if there's a match.

Von 0 auf 40 Teammitglieder – in fünf Jahren. Wir gehören als Mix aus Strategieberatung und Kreativagentur zu den am schnellsten wachsenden inhabergeführten Beratungsunternehmen Süddeutschlands und möchten unseren Weg auch in Zukunft erfolgreich fortsetzen.

Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen – wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und gleichermaßen etablierten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs Karriere zu machen und Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und freundschaftlichen Teams zu werden, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgaben

Dein Part in unserem Team.
Tätigkeiten.

So etwas wie einen typischen Arbeitstag gibt es bei uns nicht. Wir entwickeln uns als Unternehmen stets weiter und erwarten dies auch von dir. Dabei bieten wir dir ein breites und vielschichtiges Spektrum an Aufgaben, das wir gerne nach deinen individuellen Stärken gewichten können.

  • Vom Kick-off bis zur laufenden Betreuung begleitest du unsere Kunden vollumfänglich in den Bereichen Strategie, Branding, Marketing und Recruiting
  • Du begleitest Status Quo Analysen zur bisherigen Außendarstellung, Positionierung und internen Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit
  • Du entwickelst mit deinen Kollegen Marketing- und Recruiting-Strategien. Gemeinsam mit den einzelnen Fachabteilungen setzt du diese strategisch, kreativ und kommunikativ um – z.B. auf Websites oder in Social Media Kampagnen
  • Du bist direkter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und koordinierst unsere internen Fachabteilungen, wie z.B. Design, Redaktion, Performance-Marketing, Videoproduktion
  • Du bringst dich in die strategische Weiterentwicklung von TaxIt Consulting ein

Qualifikation

Was wir uns von dir wünschen.
Dein Profil.

Einen tadellosen Lebenslauf und Bestnoten? Das ist gut und wird bei uns auch honoriert, muss aber nicht sein. Wir interessieren uns vor allem für dich als Menschen und prüfen immer individuell, ob deine Erwartungen, deine Skills und dein Drive zu uns passen. Eigenschaften wie selbstständiges Arbeiten, ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch, Ownership und Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber Neuem solltest du dabei auf jeden Fall mitbringen.

Zusätzlich sind folgende Eigenschaften für deine Stelle von Relevanz.

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise mit einem Hintergrund in Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaft, Wirtschaft oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
  • Du kannst Projekte managen: theoretisches Projektmanagementwissen wird bestenfalls durch erste Kenntnisse im Personalmarketing, Employer Branding oder Online-Marketing ergänzt
  • Dienstreisen sind für dich eine willkommene Abwechslung zu online Meetings. 1–2 Tage pro Monate verbringst du vor Ort bei Kunden in ganz Deutschland
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Arbeitserfahrung bei Beratungen, Agenturen oder Personal (-marketing) Abteilungen von Unternehmen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit, Teamfähigkeit und Motivation sind Teil deiner Persönlichkeit

Benefits

Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind.
Unser Profil.

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. Wer hoch hinaus möchte, bekommt früh viel Verantwortung und Entwicklungschancen, wer sich noch unsicher ist, wo es hingehen soll, wird an die Hand genommen und erhält Orientierung. Wir sind keine Chefs, Mitarbeiter und Praktikanten, wir sind ein eingeschworenes Team, das zusammen an einem Strang zieht.

Darüber hinaus kannst du dich bei uns auf die folgenden Punkte freuen:

  • Attraktive Vergütungschancen und durchlässige Karrierestrukturen – bei uns bestimmen dein Einsatz und deine Leistung deinen künftigen Karriereweg
  • Eine steile Lernkurve als echter Benefit statt Buzzword – bei uns kümmern sich engagierte Mentoren von renommierten Unternehmensberatungen und Universitäten um deine Entwicklung
  • Arbeit mit Impact – profitiere von direktem Austausch mit Geschäftsführern unserer mittelständischen Kunden und arbeite so an Themen, die wirklich zügig und gewinnbringend umgesetzt werden
  • Flexibilität, die du dir verdienst – deine gute Arbeit wird nicht nur finanziell wertgeschätzt. Wir geben dir auch mit individuellen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten die Freiheiten, die du benötigst
  • Das passende Umfeld – ob „State of the Art“ in Sachen Ausstattung mit Laptop, Firmenhandy, höhenverstellbaren Tischen oder coolen Teamevents wie zuletzt z.B. Workation in Barcelona und Griechenland, Golfen, oder Kochkursen. Bei TaxIt macht die Arbeit noch Spaß
  • Mehr von deinem Brutto – wir sorgen mit Zusatzleistungen wie einem Deutschlandticket, einem monatlichen 50€ Einkaufsgutschein oder der Fitnessstudiomitgliedschaft (Urban Sports Club) für mehr Netto vom Brutto auf deinem Konto

Jetzt bist du dran.

Es gibt Chancen im Leben, die man nicht verpassen sollte. Das ist eine davon. Schicke uns jetzt deine Bewerbung über das digitale Bewerbungsformular und lerne uns persönlich kennen.

jobs.description:
Head of People Operations Head of People Operation

Location: Karlsruhe, Germany (hybrid)

Company: ILOS Projects GmbH & Co. KG

Scope: Full-time, permanent

WHO ARE ILOS?

ILOS is a fast-growing renewable energy company with a strong presence across Europe, backed by BNP Paribas Asset Management Alts and committed to accelerating the energy transition. Since 2018, we have developed, built, and operated large-scale solar PV projects across seven core markets.

THE ROLE OVERVIEW

ILOS is seeking a hands-on Head of People Operations to lead and strengthen its HR function as the business grows across seven European markets. Reporting directly to the C-level leadership team, you will lead and develop the existing HR team while taking personal responsibility for complex people matters, operational quality and the foundations needed for a scalable international organisation.

Working closely with Finance, Legal, management, local advisers and the wider business, you will bring structure to payroll oversight, employment contracts, people-cost planning and HR processes. You will provide trusted, practical guidance to managers, develop consistent international standards and use reliable people data to support informed decisions and a positive employee experience.

TASKS

  • Lead and develop the HR team, providing hands-on support, clear responsibilities and quality assurance across onboarding, employee administration, contracts, payroll coordination and recruitment.
  • Oversee payroll and employment contracts, establishing a reliable four-eyes review process and coordinating with payroll providers, tax advisers, Legal and external counsel across relevant countries.
  • Manage complex employee-relations and employment-law matters, including performance, absence, parental leave, flexible working and exits, and advise managers with support from Legal or external counsel where needed.
  • Own headcount and personnel-cost planning with Finance, including budgets, forecasts, scenario analysis and cost-centre allocation; explain variances and provide clear insight to management.
  • Maintain accurate, complete employee and workforce data, including joiners, leavers, contract and salary changes and absences, and provide a reliable source of headcount and FTE information for reporting.
  • Develop meaningful HR KPIs and reporting, covering workforce costs, turnover, time-to-hire, absence and span of control, and support the data required for applicable pay-transparency reporting.
  • Standardise and document HR processes, improve Factorial and related systems, and establish practical performance, employee-development and compensation processes, including salary bands and job levels.
  • Develop consistent HR standards across ILOS’ European markets while respecting local employment requirements, and coordinate international employment matters with local advisers.


PROFILE

  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Business or Employment Law, or a comparable discipline.
  • At least 5 years of generalist HR experience in a comparable scale-up, mid-sized or project-based business, including experience building and improving HR structures.
  • Strong practical payroll knowledge, including wage tax, social security and continued pay, with the ability to review and oversee payroll rather than personally process every payroll run.
  • Practical experience with employment contracts, employee relations and complex HR matters, knowing when to involve Legal and external counsel.
  • Proven experience of headcount and personnel-cost planning with Finance, including budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, scenarios and management reporting.
  • Experience leading and developing an existing HR team, with a collaborative, hands-on approach and the ability to advise managers on sensitive people matters.
  • Experience in an international organisation, with the confidence to work with local advisers across different employment jurisdictions; knowledge of cross-border employment or collectively regulated markets would be advantageous.
  • Practical DATEV experience or a strong understanding of its HR, payroll and Finance interfaces; familiarity with Factorial or similar HR systems and salary-band or job-architecture development is advantageous. Fluent German and English are essential.


Become part of a committed team shaping the future of clean energy, together.

CONTACT

Do you have questions about your career at ILOS? We’re here for you!
Whether it's about open positions, the application process, or our work environment – our HR team will be happy to support you.

Contact our Talent Acquisition Manager, Toby Barbieri – -----

jobs.description:
Team Lead Data Science – Pricing & Forecasting (m/f/x)

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to join our Data department and lead the Data Science team behind rebuy’s dynamic pricing: the people and the roadmap for the forecasting and price elasticity models that steer our high-stakes commercial decisions.

At rebuy, data science isn’t a side project. The models your team builds ship to production and directly shape what we buy, what we sell and at what price. We care about outcomes, not just predictions, and we’re looking for someone who connects commercial priorities with technical execution.

You are a player-coach: you lead from inside the work. Sometimes that means unblocking your team, aligning requirements with Commercial or translating business strategy into clear technical deliverables. Sometimes it means reviewing an architecture, pairing on a tricky modeling problem or shipping code yourself. You set the priorities and the pace, make sure the team’s work reaches production, and keep the quality bar high across our models and pipelines.

Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and grow your team: Manage, mentor and coach a focused team of Senior Data Scientists through regular 1:1s, clear performance expectations and support for their career growth. Build a culture where impact counts more than model accuracy alone

  • Own the roadmap: Work with Commercial and Data leadership to turn commercial goals into an actionable data science roadmap. Own prioritization, capacity planning and sprint execution, and make the call when not everything fits

  • Stay hands-on: Keep engineering and modeling standards high. Take part in architecture design, code reviews, feature research and modeling work alongside your team, and keep shipping code yourself

  • Make sure it works in reality: Design and run A/B tests for new launches, and make sure forecasting models get rigorous offline validation and backtesting before they go live

  • Bridge business and tech: Translate commercial needs into technical requirements and technical trade-offs into business language. Keep stakeholders informed early and build trust in what the models do


Requirements:

  • Substantial experience in data science, including at least 2 years leading or managing data scientists or ML engineers. You’re accountable for results, not only for model quality, and you’re comfortable owning and reporting on the impact of your team’s work

  • A strong quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or similar, or equivalent practical experience), with strong Python and SQL and experience bringing ML models to production

  • Hands-on experience with forecasting and pricing models: classical forecasting, ML (e.g. linear models, LightGBM/XGBoost) and rigorous time-series backtesting. You don’t need to know every method, but you can challenge modeling choices and form an objective view of your team’s work

  • Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, and a solid grasp of causal inference

  • The ability to flex between roadmap discussions with Commercial, sprint planning with your team and debugging a model in a notebook

  • Clear communication of model behavior, uncertainty and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and fast, well-reasoned prioritization when not everything fits

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • German (a big plus)

  • Experience in high-volume e-commerce, retail or marketplaces, ideally in re-commerce or secondary markets

  • Probabilistic/Bayesian modeling (e.g. PyMC)

  • Experience with Snowflake/Snowpark (or Spark), dbt and Airflow; ML workloads on Kubernetes, on a platform run by a dedicated team

  • You use AI coding and research tools in your daily work and help your team do the same

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 1 day per week)

Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin)

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Openup

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

  • Build automated workflows that identify vulnerabilities early, enforce secure configurations, and strengthen our CI/CD and cloud security controls.

  • Being highly self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership for Strava’s application, infrastructure, and network security posture.

  • Driving secure-by-design practices across engineering teams, including threat modeling, architecture reviews, and vulnerability management.

  • Embracing the usefulness of generative AI tools and applying them to your daily work.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard
  • Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room
  • Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery
  • Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand
  • Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products

Requirements

Two things matter most:

Taste. You have a distinct eye and a strong point of view, and you can build a visual world that looks like nobody else's. Everything you make feels considered, right down to the type.

Thinking. You start from the idea. You can take a strategy and a belief and turn them into a system with a reason behind every choice, and you can explain those reasons in plain words to anyone in the company.

Beyond that, we want someone with deep craft in typography, colour and composition, who has built or evolved an identity system that went live in the real world, and who moves fast without letting quality slip. We expect you to have 5+ years experience, ideally at a top studio or on an in-house team at a brand people admire. Motion, 3D or packaging experience is a bonus.

jobs.title: Intelligence Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Intelligence Specialist (m/w/d)

FOREUS

In einer Welt, in der Informationen im Überfluss vorhanden sind, wird die Fähigkeit, relevante Informationen zu identifizieren, zu verifizieren und miteinander in Verbindung zu bringen, zu einem entscheidenden strategischen Vorteil.

FOREUS ist ein international ausgerichtetes Private Intelligence Unternehmen, das nachrichtendienstliche Methoden, modernste Technologien und menschliche Analysekompetenz miteinander verbindet.

Wir untersuchen komplexe wirtschaftliche, digitale und sicherheitsrelevante Sachverhalte, analysieren internationale Netzwerke und schaffen belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Unternehmen, Finanzinstitutionen, Rechtsanwaltskanzleien und institutionelle Entscheidungsträger.

Für unsere Intelligence Operations suchen wir einen Intelligence Specialist, der analytisches Denken, technisches Verständnis und nachrichtendienstliche Neugier miteinander verbindet.

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Durchführung nationaler und internationaler Intelligence Investigations.

  • Systematische Informationsbeschaffung mittels Open Source Intelligence (OSINT).

  • Durchführung von Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT) und Analyse digitaler Identitäten.

  • Identifikation, Analyse und Visualisierung komplexer Personen-, Unternehmens- und Organisationsnetzwerke.

  • Untersuchung internationaler Unternehmensstrukturen, Beteiligungsverhältnisse und wirtschaftlicher Verflechtungen.

  • Analyse digitaler Spuren, öffentlich zugänglicher Datenbestände und digitaler Infrastrukturen.

  • Identifikation und Analyse von Desinformation, Fake-Profilen und koordinierten digitalen Aktivitäten.

  • Informationsbeschaffung im Surface Web, Deep Web und in rechtmässig zugänglichen Bereichen des Darknets.

  • Mitarbeit an komplexen Mandaten in den Bereichen Wirtschaftskriminalität, Betrug, Asset Tracing und Due Diligence.

  • Durchführung von Financial Intelligence (FININT) und Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Analysen.

  • Strukturierung, Aufbereitung und Verknüpfung grosser Informationsbestände.

  • Quellenbewertung, Informationsverifizierung und Entwicklung analytischer Hypothesen.

  • Erstellung professioneller Intelligence Reports, Dossiers und Lagebilder.

  • Entwicklung neuer nachrichtendienstlicher Recherche- und Analysemethoden.

  • Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung proprietärer FOREUS Intelligence-Technologien.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Intelligence Specialists, Ermittlern und Technologieexperten.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keine klassischen Recherchemitarbeiter. Wir suchen Menschen, die unkonventionell denken, komplexe Zusammenhänge erkennen und sich nicht mit oberflächlichen Antworten zufriedengeben.

  • Berufserfahrung im Bereich Intelligence, OSINT, digitale Ermittlungen oder vergleichbaren Tätigkeitsfeldern.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse digitaler Informationsbeschaffungs- und Analysemethoden.

  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches, logisches und vernetztes Denkvermögen.

  • Technisches Verständnis digitaler Plattformen, Datenbanken und Informationssysteme.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit professionellen Recherche- und Analysewerkzeugen.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe und widersprüchliche Informationen kritisch zu bewerten.

  • Strukturierte, präzise und nachvollziehbare Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit und professionelle Berichterstattung.

  • Verständnis rechtlicher und datenschutzrechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen der Informationsbeschaffung.

  • Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative, Belastbarkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Absolute Diskretion und persönliche Integrität.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Weitere Fremdsprachen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Besonders interessant sind für uns Kenntnisse in folgenden Bereichen:

  • Open Source Intelligence (OSINT)

  • Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT)

  • Financial Intelligence (FININT)

  • Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT)

  • Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI)

  • Digital Forensics

  • Blockchain Intelligence

  • Dark Web Intelligence

  • Corporate Investigations

  • Link Analysis & Network Mapping

  • Data Mining & Data Analysis

  • Artificial Intelligence

  • Research Automation

Ein akademischer Abschluss ist für uns nicht zwingend erforderlich. Entscheidend sind deine tatsächlichen Fähigkeiten, deine analytische Kompetenz und die Qualität deiner Arbeit.

Bewerbungen von ehemaligen Mitarbeitern staatlicher Nachrichtendienste, Sicherheitsbehörden und militärischer Nachrichteneinheiten sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Benefits

  • Mitarbeit an komplexen nationalen und internationalen Intelligence-Mandaten.

  • Zugang zu proprietären Intelligence-Technologien und professionellen Analysewerkzeugen.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Experten aus Nachrichtendienst, Sicherheit, Wirtschaft und Technologie.

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung neuer Intelligence-Methoden und technologischer Lösungen.

  • Kontinuierliche fachliche Weiterentwicklung und individuelle Spezialisierung.

  • Internationale Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der FOREUS Group.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und analytischer Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine leistungsorientierte Unternehmenskultur.

  • Attraktive, qualifikations- und leistungsabhängige Vergütung.

Think beyond the obvious.

Intelligence ist keine gewöhnliche berufliche Tätigkeit. Es ist eine Art zu denken, Informationen zu hinterfragen, Muster zu erkennen und Unsicherheit in belastbare Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln.

Wir suchen Menschen, die dort weiterdenken, wo andere aufhören. Menschen, die nicht nur wissen wollen, was passiert ist, sondern auch verstehen wollen, warum es passiert ist und welche Zusammenhänge dahinterstehen.

Wenn du bereit bist, deine Fähigkeiten in einem international ausgerichteten Private Intelligence Unternehmen einzusetzen und die Zukunft dieser Branche aktiv mitzugestalten, dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

FOREUS – True Realities.

Stage – Assistant marketing digital & commercial – Voyages d’aventure

D'abord, quelques mots sur nous

Chez Nature Occitane, nous avons une conviction : les plus beaux voyages ne sont pas forcément ceux qui nous emmènent le plus loin.

Tour-opérateur réceptif (DMC) indépendant, nous concevons et organisons des voyages à pied, à vélo et multiactivités en famille, en liberté ou accompagnés.

Du Canal du Midi aux Pyrénées, en passant par les Cévennes, l'Aubrac et la Catalogne, nous invitons nos voyageurs à découvrir les territoires autrement, à leur rythme et au plus près de la nature.

Notre ambition ? Développer une autre façon de voyager, plus respectueuse de l'environnement et des territoires, en privilégiant les mobilités douces, les expériences authentiques et les rencontres locales.

Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire passionné(e) de voyages et d'outdoor pour rejoindre notre équipe d'Alénya.

Tes missions

Aux côtés de notre équipe, tu participeras activement au développement de la notoriété de Nature Occitane, à la visibilité de nos voyages et à leur commercialisation.

Ton stage s'articulera autour de deux missions complémentaires : le marketing digital (80 %) et le conseil et la vente de voyages (20 %).

1. Marketing digital – 4 jours par semaine

  • SEO et rédaction web : participer à l'optimisation du référencement naturel de notre nouveau site internet, rédiger et enrichir les contenus de nos pages destinations, séjours et articles de blog.

  • Acquisition digitale (SEA) : participer au suivi et à l'analyse de nos campagnes publicitaires, en collaboration avec nos prestataires spécialisés.

  • Newsletters et CRM : participer à la conception, à la rédaction et à la diffusion de nos campagnes d'e-mailing, ainsi qu'à la segmentation de notre base de contacts.

  • Réseaux sociaux : contribuer à l'élaboration du calendrier éditorial, à la création de contenus et à l'animation de nos communautés.

  • Analyse des performances : suivre les principaux indicateurs marketing, analyser les résultats des actions menées et proposer des pistes d'amélioration.

  • Développement marketing : contribuer à la réflexion et à la mise en œuvre d'actions visant à développer la visibilité et les ventes sur l'ensemble de notre offre de voyages.

2. Conseil & vente de voyages – 1 jour par semaine

  • Accompagner nos clients dans le choix de leurs voyages à pied, à vélo ou en famille.

  • Participer à la préparation des devis et des propositions personnalisées.

  • Participer au suivi des demandes commerciales et contribuer à leur concrétisation.

  • Identifier les attentes et les motivations de nos voyageurs afin d'enrichir nos actions marketing.

Cette immersion commerciale te permettra de mieux comprendre nos clients, nos produits et les réalités de notre métier, pour donner davantage de sens à tes actions marketing.

Ces missions pourront évoluer au cours du stage, en fonction de tes compétences, de tes objectifs pédagogiques et des projets de l'entreprise.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Tu es étudiant(e) en marketing digital, communication ou école de commerce, idéalement en Master 2 à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études.

jobs.title: Product Owner Open Source – Signalisation ferroviaire - FREELANCE
jobs.description:
Product Owner Open Source – Signalisation ferroviaire - FREELANCE

La mission en bref

  • Contrat — Mission freelance.

  • Démarrage prévisionnel — Mi-décembre 2026.

  • Durée initiale — 5,5 mois à temps plein.

  • Tranche optionnelle — 7 mois, à compter de juin 2027 à titre prévisionnel, sous réserve d’activation.

  • Lieu — Saint-Denis, avec possibilité de télétravail. Rythme de présence sur site à confirmer.

Contexte de la mission

ImaginePartners recherche un Product Owner Open Source pour accompagner un acteur du secteur ferroviaire dans l’ouverture d’un logiciel de signalisation. Vous piloterez la préparation de l’ouverture et construirez une feuille de route commune aux versions interne et open source. Si la tranche optionnelle est activée, vous assurerez le suivi produit des contributions externes et des publications.

Vos missions

Préparer l’ouverture du logiciel

  • Définir la vision produit, les usages cibles et les jalons d’ouverture. Construire une feuille de route qui articule les évolutions des versions interne et open source.

  • Structurer et prioriser le backlog GitLab. Rédiger les besoins, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation, puis participer aux cycles agiles.

  • Définir avec les équipes techniques le périmètre du code et de la documentation à publier. Coordonner les validations juridiques, de confidentialité et de sécurité.

  • Proposer la gouvernance et le circuit de contribution, puis préparer le dossier de candidature auprès d’OpenRail.

  • Coordonner les équipes métier, les équipes techniques et les partenaires. Suivre l’avancement, les risques et les décisions à soumettre au comité de pilotage.

Suivre les contributions et les publications si l’option est activée

  • Qualifier les contributions externes, échanger avec les contributeurs et coordonner les revues avec les mainteneurs.

  • Préparer les versions publiques et leurs notes de version, tenir à jour la feuille de route publique et animer les échanges avec la communauté.

  • Suivre les écarts entre les deux versions du logiciel et coordonner l’analyse de leurs impacts sur les exigences, les essais et la qualification.

Livrables attendus

  • Note de cadrage et plan de montée en compétence.

  • Cartographie des composants et documents à publier, à conserver en interne ou à exclure, et registre des validations.

  • Feuille de route consolidée, plan d’ouverture et backlog GitLab priorisé.

  • Gouvernance des contributions, matrice des responsabilités, dossier OpenRail et guide de contribution.

  • Dossier de préparation à l’ouverture, supports de pilotage et dossier de passation.

  • Si l’option est activée, registre des contributions, notes de version et bilan communautaire.

Profil recherché

Compétences attendues

  • Expérience de Product Owner sur un produit logiciel, avec pratique du cadrage, de la priorisation et du pilotage d’une feuille de route.

  • Expérience concrète de mise en open source d’un logiciel ou de gouvernance d’un projet open source avec des mainteneurs et des contributeurs externes.

  • Pratique de GitLab ou d’un outil équivalent pour suivre les demandes et les contributions.

  • Capacité à coordonner des interlocuteurs métier, techniques, juridiques et sécurité, et à préparer des arbitrages documentés.

Atouts

  • Expérience du ferroviaire ou d’un environnement soumis à des exigences de qualification logicielle.

  • Expérience de coordination des publications et d’animation d’une communauté open source.

Candidature

  • Votre CV.

  • Votre date de disponibilité.

  • Votre TJM HT.

  • Votre statut (société, indépendant ou portage salarial).

  • Votre localisation.

  • Votre capacité à intervenir sur site à Saint-Denis.

  • Un exemple de projet open source, en précisant votre rôle et les résultats obtenus.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • New office in Zürich Kreis 5

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

  • Work directly with the founders
