jobs.title: Senior Process Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Process Integration Engineer

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Senior Process Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in translating new technologies and products from development into robust, scalable, and manufacturable processes. You will work closely with Engineering, R&D, Product, Operations, and Quality teams to develop, integrate, optimise, and release processes and products into manufacturing.

Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the integration and transfer of new products, processes and technologies from R&D into manufacturing.

  • Define and develop manufacturing process flows, process specifications and control strategies for new product introductions.

  • Work closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to ensure new products are designed and released with manufacturability, quality and scalability in mind.

  • Plan and execute process integration activities, including process development, qualification, validation, and release.

  • Identify, investigate and resolve process integration issues, yield losses, and technical anomalies.

  • Drive continuous process and yield improvements using structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches.

  • Support the transition and scaling of manufacturing capabilities, including the implementation of new equipment, automation, and MES systems.

  • Develop and maintain key process and quality documentation, including Process FMEAs, Control Plans, process specifications, work instructions and change control documentation.

  • Participate in and support technical review and decision-making processes, including Change Control Boards (CCB) and Material Review Boards (MRB).

  • Work with Operations and Manufacturing teams to establish stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes.

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers as the Process Integration team grows.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role.

  • A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

  • Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment.

  • Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer.

  • Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools.

  • Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield.

  • Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions.

  • Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

  • Experience with semiconductor fabrication of superconducting devices or quantum technologies would be a nice to have.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Lead whose primary goal is to get distribution and drive revenue for Fin’s global payments app.

You’ll focus on finding and closing partners who can put Fin in front of more users, drive meaningful payment volume and revenue, and embed Fin into existing workflows or products.

Stablecoins are transforming the payments landscape, enabling money to move faster, cheaper, and across borders with ease. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in shaping the future of global money movement.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and prioritize high-potential partners (platforms, products, or channels) where embedding or routing payments through Fin is an obvious win.

  • Open doors and pitch Fin, building relationships with BD, product, and executive stakeholders, and getting them excited about working with us.

  • Structure and negotiate deals that make sense for both sides (commercial terms, incentives, simple success metrics) and are realistic for an early-stage team to support.

  • Work with product and engineering to define straightforward integration paths and keep partnerships moving from idea → signed → live.

  • Bring market and partner insight back into Fin, influencing roadmap and GTM with real-world feedback from the ecosystem.

Qualifications

  • A track record of turning partnerships into real distribution or revenue.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage, low-process environment where you have to create structure as you go.

jobs.description:
AI-First Adoption Lead (m/w/d) KI- Einführung und Prozessautomatisierung

Jobbeschreibung

Wer wir sind

benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken.

Worum es geht

benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage:

benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet.

  • Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort.
  • Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar.
  • Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament.

Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows.

Warum wir das machen

Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.
  • Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig.
  • Anforderungen schärfen: Du übersetzt den Bedarf der Teams in vollständige Anforderungen mit Problem, Ablauf, Nutzen und Abnahmekriterium und bringst sie in die Weiterentwicklung von benuta Nexus ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge verantworten: Du führst unsere KI-gestützten Lösungen, etwa im Kundenservice und im Bewertungsmanagement, und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Ergebnisse dort ankommen, wo daraus Verbesserungen werden.
  • Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bringst du mit

Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen.

  • Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat.
  • Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt.
  • Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
  • Starke Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, überzeugst vor Gruppen und im Einzelgespräch und schreibst präzise.
  • Hands-on und Tempo: Du bist Macher, nicht Verwalter. Du packst selbst an, treibst Themen mit Energie voran und fühlst dich in einem hohen Tempo wohl.
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in E-Commerce, Handel oder Logistik sowie mit Modellen von Google, OpenAI oder Anthropic. Die Modelle bei uns sind gesetzt; entscheidend ist, was du damit im Prozess erreichst.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

Deine Mission

Wie baut man aus einem erfolgreichen Vertriebskanal ein skalierbares Geschäftsmodell?

Als Venture Development Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für einen unserer zentralen externen Vertriebspartner im Wärmepumpengeschäft. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und hast die Möglichkeit, einen wichtigen Vertriebskanal von Enpal aktiv mitzugestalten. We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control.

This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody and scales UK retail options trading. Rather than running a static checklist, you'll help build and refine our operational controls and CASS processes as we launch new products.

What the role involves

1. Risk & Control Operations

  • CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations.

  • CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed.

  • KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations.

  • Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews.

  • Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies.

2. Business Oversight & Governance Support

  • Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight.

  • Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules.

  • Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm.

  • Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support.

  • Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail.

Your Background

Desirable

  • Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

jobs.title: Founder & CEO — AI Complaint Resolution
jobs.description:
Founder & CEO — AI Complaint Resolution

Founder & CEO — AI Complaint Resolution

Complaints are being written by AI. Build the AI that resolves them fairly, for every regulated business. Build the next generation of complaint and regulated-request handling, for a world where customers' AI writes the complaint.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

Complaints are changing faster than the teams that handle them. Generative AI makes complaints longer and easier to file: the Financial Ombudsman says up to a third of responses to its initial assessments now look AI-generated, and it has seen 200-page submissions in reply to an eight-page decision. Soon personal agents will file and chase complaints for people, so one event becomes several. UK financial services firms received 1.85 million complaints in the first half of 2026, up 6.3%, and a human still has to read and check every one. Every ombudsman referral can cost a firm £680.

It isn't only financial complaints. New kinds of regulated requests are arriving that no off-the-shelf tool handles well, such as waves of GDPR data requests from job candidates a company never hired. Each one raises the same questions: why is this happening, do we have to respond, and how do we respond fairly and on time?

We are building the AI desk that handles them. It splits a long complaint or request into its separate claims, checks each one against the policy, the customer's records and the rules, and drafts a fair, cited response within the deadline, with a handler always making the decision. jobs.title: Thèse : Développement d'un concept de bâtiment de ligne d'assemblage final d'avion (FAL) écoresponsable - CDD 36 mois
jobs.description:
Thèse : Développement d'un concept de bâtiment de ligne d'assemblage final d'avion (FAL) écoresponsable - CDD 36 mois

Établissement : IMT Mines Albi, France

École doctorale : Mécanique, Énergétique, Génie civil et Procédés (MEGEP), Université de Toulouse

Laboratoire de recherche : RAPSODEE – IMT Mines Albi – UMR CNRS 5302, France

Encadrant : Yasmine Lalau, Mathieu Milhé, Elsa Weiss-Hortala

Lieu : Albi (RAPSODEE CNRS–IMT Mines Albi)

Financement : DGAC, projet FORCE

Date de début : Mars 2026

Description du poste :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le projet FORCE, porté par Airbus Opérations et financé par la DGAC. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité.

Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone.

Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. Un bâtiment de cette envergure, intégrant une ligne mobile, possède alors peu de cloisons, une hauteur sous plafond élevée, et la dalle de sol doit être renforcée et plane pour assurer le déplacement de la ligne mobile, tout en accueillant les alimentations électriques (câbles électriques ou batteries). Ces contraintes structurales impactent directement la localisation des unités de chauffage et de climatisation et la régulation de l’humidité. Dans ce contexte particulier d’une FAL, la conception du bâtiment est un problème complexe nécessitant d’optimiser simultanément plusieurs paramètres :

  • Les dimensions du bâtiment et le positionnement des cloisons internes et unités de chauffage et climatisation devront être optimisés dans le respect des contraintes techniques d’assemblage et de régulation de la température et de l’humidité. Dans un second temps, la zone bureau sera intégrée, avec un objectif de confort intérieur différent.

  • L’introduction de sas (dimensions à étudier) vise directement à constituer un effet tampon pour faciliter la régulation du confort intérieur (température, humidité) lors des séquences d’ouverture et fermeture des portails. La disposition des sas dépend aussi de la localisation des éléments de chauffage et de climatisation.

  • La consommation énergétique est liée au chauffage, à la climatisation mais aussi à l’éclairage.

    En effet, les opérations d’assemblage nécessitent une luminosité constante sur les différents postes d’assemblage, parfois à des hauteurs différentes. La consommation énergétique liée au confort intérieur (température, humidité) est particulièrement complexe à optimiser et à homogénéiser dans le bâtiment en raison de son envergure et du faible nombre de cloisons disponibles. Une étude d’intégration d’énergies renouvelables est prévue sur les aspects chaleur et électricité, notamment en prenant en compte l’alimentation électrique directe ou indirecte par batteries de la ligne mobile.

  • L’impact énergétique, environnemental et la résilience du bâtiment en fonction de son implantation et de l’évolution des conditions climatiques sera étudié. Les simulations seront alors réalisées pour des localisations correspondant à des conditions météorologiques de plus en plus sévères afin de tester la résilience.

Ces verrous scientifiques et techniques associés directement à la typologie du bâtiment FAL et des matériaux sélectionnés seront supportés par la simulation thermique dynamique (STD) des scénarios d’usage étudiés, par l’analyse de cycle de vie (ACV) du bâtiment et par des analyses d’impacts.

Mots-clés

Bâtiment industriel de grande envergure, indicateurs de performance énergétique et environnementale, confort intérieur, résilience, bâtiment écoresponsable, simulation thermique dynamique (STD)

Compétences :

Il est attendu que le/la candidat(e) soit titulaire d’un bac+5 en génie énergétique ou ingénierie de la performance.

Le/la candidat(e) devra posséder de solides connaissances associées au génie climatique et énergétique (en particulier les solutions d’énergies renouvelables et les systèmes CVC) et au management de la performance (notamment les indicateurs de performance industrielle et les indicateurs énergétiques et environnementaux). Une première expérience en simulation thermique du bâtiment est nécessaire. Une connaissance de l’environnement d’une ligne d’assemblage final d’avions et en particulier les contraintes associées à la typologie du bâtiment est un plus. Une première expérience d’analyse de cycle de vie serait aussi un plus.

jobs.description:
Acquisition Operations

Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

 

What you'll build

Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days)

  • Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it.

  • Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call.

  • Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.

Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9)

  • Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.

  • Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing.

  • Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters.

Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond)

  • Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel.

  • Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously.

  • Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it.

 

Why this role

  • Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days.

  • Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you.

  • Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level.

  • A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat. The steepest learning curve we can offer.

  • A path that grows with the system: from operator to architect to leader of growth automation at Zefir.

 

Who you are

  • Top-tier problem solver: 2 to 6 years at a top strategy consultancy (BCG, McKinsey, Bain...), in Growth, Ops or Strategy at a high-growth tech company, or both. You structure messy problems in minutes and you get the math right the first time.

  • Builder at heart: you have already built something real: a model, a tool, an automation, an AI agent, a side project. SQL is second nature; Python is a strong plus. You'd rather prototype in an afternoon than debate for a week.

  • Commercial instinct: you think in revenue, not in vanity metrics. You're curious about why people click, book and buy, and you know when fewer leads is good news.

  • Systems thinker: when you see a task done twice, you design the system that removes it. You care about guardrails, feedback loops and what happens when things break.

  • Ownership and clarity: you hold a high bar, move fast and own outcomes. You write crisp updates that start with the number, the cause and the action.

  • Languages: fluency in French and English is required.

  • What we don't require: years of media buying or a marketing title. We hire for slope, not intercept: if you learn fast and build relentlessly, we'll teach you the rest.

 

Hiring process

  • 30-min call with our Talent Lead

  • 30-min interview with the hiring manager

  • 60-min live case on real (anonymised) funnel data. AI is allowed in part of the case: we want to see how you use it.

  • 15-min coffee chat with our RevOps lead and 45-min Behavioral interview with our CoFounder, then references


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - .NET Backend (Paris)
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer - .NET Backend (Paris)

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Backend teams at Trainline 👋
The Backend teams at Trainline build the core of Trainline’s world class product. We create the journey search functionality that millions of our customers use on a daily basis, the eCommerce platform that provides a secure and seamless experience and we connect Trainline to over 270 travel operating companies, across 45 countries in Europe and the rest of the world. Each team has a targeted domain focus, ranging between journey search, fares calculation, bookings, fulfilment, payments, refunds, carriers’ integrations, real-time timetable information, journey disruptions and much more.

 

About Trainline Media 📺
Trainline Media is our rapidly scaling advertising and commerce-media business. Leveraging Trainline’s scale and high-intent traveller audience, we deliver native, context-aware ad formats, sponsored journeys, and rewards across our mobile and Web platforms. Our mission is to build a premium, customer-first advertising ecosystem that enriches the passenger journey while driving sustainable commercial growth.


As a senior level .NET Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄

  • Deliver new functionality or features, using the most appropriate tools & techniques

  • Ensure quality is at the heart of everything you and your team do

  • Continuously improve the code base

  • Keep our customer as the number one priority

  • Actively identify blockers, boulders, time sinks and waste, and actively attempt to remove them

  • Make significant contribution to technical decisions

  • Act as a coach and mentor to others in the team

• Take full ownership of the development lifecycle from code to production, including deployment and monitoring


Our Tech Stack 🔑

  • Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET 6–10)

  • Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS Cloud, Docker, Terraform

  • CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions

• Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, ELK Stack


We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Experience mentoring less experienced engineers and comfortable pair-programming with colleagues

  • Hands on experience with C# .NET and the latest features

  • Experience collaborating with front-end engineers and other disciplines to deliver end-to-end features and cross-functional epics

  • Experience working with identity and authentication systems (e.g. IdentityServer, OpenID Connect, OAuth2)

  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Spacelift or similar tools)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also valuable)

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform

  • Strong experience with observability practices (logging, monitoring, alerting)

  • Familiarity with tools such as New Relic and ELK stack (or equivalents)

  • Curiosity about AI and emerging tools

  • Experience supporting production systems and improving reliability

  • Strong experience building and operating microservices architectures

  • Experience with event-driven systems and asynchronous messaging patterns

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges

  • Have excellent communication skills

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
jobs.description:
Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation

Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market.

You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners.

Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Where the website stands today

Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com. Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration.

In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of.

Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started.

AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up.

Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site.

The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked.

What you'll be doing

Run the experimentation program

  • Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout.

  • Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test.

  • Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test.

  • Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session.

Improve conversion where buyers decide

  • Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages.

  • Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it.

  • Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market.

Personalize the site

  • Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage.

  • Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what.

  • Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site.

Build AI into the web program

  • Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor.

  • Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month.

  • Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results.

  • Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions.

Manage web projects

  • Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer.

  • Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits.

  • Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result.

Keep the site findable and measurable

  • Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access.

  • Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way.

  • Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Build the weekly web performance view the team works from.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost.

  • Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships.

  • Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes.

  • AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first.

  • Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist):

  • Creative: Figma, Canva

  • Website: Framer, Contentstack

  • Analytics: HubSpot, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Fibbler, Snowflake

  • CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Experimentation and personalization: Optimizely

  • Behavior analytics: heatmaps and session recordings

  • Project management and handoff: Linear, Figma

  • AI: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills and MCP integrations), ChatGPT, and build tools such as Lovable or n8n

Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

  4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

HR Adviseur

Als HR Adviseur binnen Matrix Fitness ben je een echte HR generalist en houd jij je bezig met het algehele personeelsbeleid en de salarisadministratie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor jouw afdelingen waarvoor je het volledige HR beleid operationeel handen en voeten geeft. Is dit jouw volgende uitdaging?

Jouw sportieve uitdaging:

Het betreft een generalistische adviseursrol waarbij je jouw afdelingen faciliteert in de volledige HR dienstverlening. Van het werven van nieuwe collega’s tot het faciliteren van een goede offboarding, alle facetten komen in deze rol voorbij. Zo ben je ook verantwoordelijk voor het stroomlijnen en bijhouden van onze HR-administratie met behulp van ons personeelssysteem (AFAS) en beheer je het volledige scala aan operationele HR-taken voor het personeel. Hierbij kun je denken aan het monitoren en uitvoeren van het administratieve in- en uitdienst proces, verzuimbegeleiding van begin tot eind binnen de afdeling, het beantwoorden van HR gerelateerde vraagstukken vanuit jouw afdelingen en jouw manager en het proactief adviseren van leidinggevenden. Naast de verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw eigen afdelingen en de salarisadministratie, draag je ook de verantwoordelijkheid voor het thema ‘Vitaliteit', waarbij je een vitaliteitsdraaiboek uitvoert, bijhoudt en iedere twee jaar vernieuwd. Kortom, een veelzijdige functie waarin je de ruimte hebt om een significante impact te maken op belangrijke HR-onderwerpen binnen onze organisatie.

De organisatie bestaat uit 235 werknemers, waarvan 26 leidinggevende, verdeeld over 3 landen (België, Nederland & Denemarken). De grootste populatie is in Nederland gevestigd en de openstaande positie focust zich op het personeel in het Service Team (verdeeld over Nederland en België), het Sales Team (verdeeld over Nederland en België) en onze complete organisatie in Denemarken (12 personen). Je komt terecht in een enthousiast HR-team, bestaande uit twee andere HR Adviseurs onder leiding van de HR Manager. Dan is deze vacature wat voor jou en kijken we ernaar uit om je in ons team te verwelkomen!

De ideale kandidaat heeft:

Hier kom je terecht

Wij zijn gevestigd in Houten en de snelst groeiende leverancier van professionele fitnessapparatuur in de Benelux. Onze toestellen staan bij fitnesscentra, fysiotherapeuten, onderwijsinstellingen, hotels, bedrijven en topsport accommodaties. jobs.title: Stage of afstuderen Finance: Memoriaal Boekingen
jobs.description:
Stage of afstuderen Finance: Memoriaal Boekingen

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze stageopdracht duik je in het maandafsluitingsproces en verder optimalisering en automatisering hiervan. Je onderzoekt welke memoriaalboekingen er worden gemaakt, waarom ze ontstaan en hoeveel tijd ze kosten. Daarmee help je Finance om de doorlooptijd van de maandafsluiting te verkorten en het proces minder foutgevoelig te maken.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Inventariseren van alle memoriaal boekingen binnen het maandafsluitingsproces / analyseren van historische data;

  • Categoriseren van memoriaal boekingen (bijvoorbeeld correcties, accruals, reallocaties en eenmalige posten);

  • In kaart brengen van de tijdsbesteding per type memoriaal boeking;

  • Identificeren van oorzaken (procesmatig, datastructuur, systeembeperkingen, afhankelijkheden);

  • Vaststellen welke memoriaal boekingen structureel, repeterend of te automatiseren zijn;

  • Analyseren van de impact van memoriaal boekingen op doorlooptijd, foutgevoeligheid en controlelast.

Uiteindelijk lever je een overzicht op van alle memoriaal boekingen met tijdsbesteding en frequentie inclusief een analyse en advies van de bottlenecks en verbetermogelijkheden. Aanbevelingen voor automatisering, toepassingen van AI, standaardisatie of eliminatie van memoriaal boekingen zijn een onderdeel van jouw advies.


Wij vragen

  • HBO of WO opleiding in de richting Finance & Control of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Social Media Creative
jobs.description:
Stagiair(e) Social Media Creative

Stagiair(e) Social Media Creative

32-40 uur

Ben jij iemand die graag creatief bezig is, helemaal thuis is op social media en het leuk vindt om met de nieuwste trends aan de slag te gaan? Vind je het leuk om video's te maken en te editen, nieuwe ideeën te bedenken en content te creëren die écht opvalt? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Bij BERG krijg je de ruimte om jouw creativiteit volop in te zetten. Je draait echt mee in ons team en krijgt de vrijheid om zelf ideeën aan te dragen, content te maken en projecten op te pakken. Geen stage waarbij je alleen meekijkt, maar een plek waar je zelf aan de slag gaat, veel leert en jouw ideeën werkelijkheid ziet worden. Samen maken we er een creatieve en vooral leuke stage van!

Create your FUTURE

Als stagiair(e) Multi Media Design word jij onderdeel van ons creatieve Social Media team binnen de Branding afdeling. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw creativiteit te laten zien en werkt mee aan allerlei gave projecten. Van social media content tot 360 campagnes: jij helpt mee om BERG op een creatieve manier onder de aandacht te brengen.

 Wat ga je zoal doen?

·         Je bedenkt, ontwerpt en maakt toffe content voor onze social media kanalen.

·         Je gaat aan de slag met videomontage en grafisch ontwerp, van pakkende reels tot opvallende visuals.

·         Je helpt onze social media kanalen dagelijks up-to-date te houden.

·         Je ondersteunt bij influencer samenwerkingen en denkt mee over creatieve mogelijkheden.

·         Je werkt samen met ons creatieve team aan video- en designprojecten.

·         Je helpt mee aan onze 360 graden campagnes en krijgt een kijkje achter de schermen bij verschillende marketingactiviteiten.

 

En het leukste? Er is volop ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën en creatieve input! Zie jij een trend voorbijkomen die perfect bij BERG past? Of heb je een origineel idee voor een video? Laat maar zien!

100% YOU
Jij bent iemand die niet alleen graag creatief bezig is, maar ook niet bang is om initiatief te nemen. Je hebt gevoel voor design, weet wat er speelt op social media en krijgt energie van het maken van content die echt opvalt.

Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken, maar kunt ook prima zelfstandig aan de slag. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende projecten, denkt graag mee en houdt ervan om nieuwe dingen te leren.

Daarnaast ben jij een enthousiaste tweede- of derdejaars hbo-student Communication & Multimedia Design (of een vergelijkbare opleiding).

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

  • Je hebt een social first mindset en weet wat werkt op Instagram, TikTok en andere kanalen.

  • Je bent creatief, proactief en komt graag met nieuwe ideeën.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor grafisch design en maakt graag opvallende content.

  • Je hebt ervaring met Adobe Creative Cloud (o.a. Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop en Illustrator).

  • Je volgt de nieuwste trends op het gebied van social media, design en AI.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor detail en kunt goed omgaan met deadlines.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.

  • Je hebt een portfolio met werk waar je trots op bent!

Je hoeft natuurlijk nog niet alles te kunnen. Je komt tenslotte bij ons om te leren! Enthousiasme, creativiteit en de drive om jezelf te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
Een stage bij BERG is allesbehalve saai! Je krijgt de kans om jezelf zowel creatief als professioneel te ontwikkelen, wordt onderdeel van een gezellig team en werkt aan projecten die je straks met trots aan je portfolio kunt toevoegen.

Natuurlijk krijg je goede begeleiding, maar ook genoeg vrijheid om zelf dingen te ontdekken en initiatief te nemen. En ja, daar hoort ook een fijne stagevergoeding bij!

 Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

·         Stagevergoeding €450,- per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur)

·         Een stage van minimaal 5 maanden, vanaf februari 2027.

·         Een creatieve, inspirerende werkomgeving met enthousiaste en gezellige collega's.

·         Veel afwisseling: van video's editen tot social content ontwerpen en meedenken over campagnes. Geen dag is hetzelfde!

·         De kans om echt mee te werken aan projecten en jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen.

·         Goede begeleiding en volop ruimte om nieuwe skills te ontwikkelen.

·         Gezellige lunches, potjes tafeltennis of tafelvoetbal én natuurlijk de mogelijkheid om zelf onze trampolines uit te proberen!

·         Ruimte om aan een eigen stageopdracht te werken.

 Kortom: een plek waar je veel leert, nieuwe uitdagingen aangaat en waar hard werken en plezier maken prima samengaan!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Performance- Weights & Biases
jobs.description:
Staff Software Engineer, Performance- Weights & Biases

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

Weights & Biases at CoreWeave

CoreWeave acquired Weights & Biases to create the most powerful end-to-end platform to develop, deploy, and iterate AI faster. CoreWeave operates a growing footprint of data centers covering every region of the US and across Europe, and was ranked as one of the TIME100 most influential companies of 2024. By bringing together CoreWeave’s industry-leading cloud infrastructure with the best-in-class tools AI practitioners know and love from Weights & Biases, we’re setting a new standard for how AI is built, trained, and scaled.

The integration of our teams and technologies is accelerating our shared mission: to empower developers with the tools and infrastructure they need to push the boundaries of what AI can do. From experiment tracking and model optimization to high-performance training clusters, agent building, and inference at scale, we’re combining forces to serve the full AI lifecycle — all in one seamless platform.

Weights & Biases has long been trusted by over 1,500 organizations — including AstraZeneca, Canva, Cohere, OpenAI, Meta, Snowflake, Square, Toyota, and Wayve — to build better models, AI agents and applications. Now, as part of CoreWeave, that impact is amplified across a broader ecosystem of AI innovators, researchers, and enterprises.

As we unite under one vision, we’re looking for bold thinkers and agile builders who are excited to shape the future of AI alongside us. If you’re passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and AI, there’s never been a more exciting time to join our team.

What You’ll Do:

Performance Engineering at Weights & Biases ensures our systems and products scale seamlessly as usage grows. We embed performance thinking into every stage of development—diagnosing issues, designing scalable patterns, and building tools that empower every engineering team to deliver fast, efficient, and reliable experiences. Our mission is to make performance a shared responsibility across the company through data, automation, and collaboration.

About the role:

As a Staff Engineer on the Performance Engineering team, you’ll take technical ownership of complex performance challenges across the W&B platform and infrastructure. You’ll design and lead experiments to improve system scalability and latency, develop standardized benchmarking and load testing frameworks, and drive initiatives to prevent regressions across product surfaces. You’ll collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and SRE teams, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic understanding of system behavior. Day to day, you’ll blend investigation, architecture, and enablement—helping teams measure, understand, and continuously improve performance.

Who You Are:

  • 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2 years focused on performance optimization, systems scalability, or observability.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, with strong systems-level debugging and profiling skills.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts (caching, queuing, concurrency, resource contention, etc.) and their performance implications.
  • Experience designing and implementing load testing, benchmarking, or performance regression frameworks (e.g., Locust, Gatling, k6, custom solutions).
  • Familiarity with metrics and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.) and performance data analysis.
  • Experience integrating performance measurement into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to design experiments, analyze large datasets, and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives from design through adoption.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience in performance engineering or SRE at scale (e.g., supporting multi-region, high-throughput systems).
  • Familiarity with frontend performance monitoring and web vitals.
  • Experience building developer-facing tools or frameworks.
  • Background in data systems, observability, or ML infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to open-source performance or benchmarking tools.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love to turn messy, complex performance problems into clear, data-backed stories that lead to concrete action.
  • You’re curious about how systems behave under real-world load and enjoy building experiments that reveal what’s really happening under the hood.
  • You’re an expert in transforming deep technical insights into tools and processes that empower other engineers to build faster, more reliable systems.
  • You find satisfaction in long-term, cross-team collaboration — helping others succeed by embedding performance thinking into their workflows.
  • You get energy from bridging theory and practice: designing scalable architectures and writing the code that proves them out.
  • You care deeply about measurement, iteration, and continuous improvement — not just fixing bottlenecks, but preventing them from ever recurring.

Why Us?

We work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $188,000 to $275,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance
  • Short and long-term disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
  • Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health
  • Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
  • 401(k) with a generous employer match
  • Flexible PTO
  • Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
  • A casual work environment
  • A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. jobs.title: Senior Manager AI Content
jobs.description:
Senior Manager AI Content

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas die Zukunft der Content-Erstellung mit generativer KI gestalten? Du hast Freude daran, intelligente Workflows, Prompts und Agents aufzusetzen und mit ihrer Hilfe hochwertigen Content für eine der führenden Gesundheitsmarken Europas zu entwickeln? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Manager AI Content (w/m/d), der unsere Marke Kijimea mit einer zukunftsweisenden AI-first-Content-Strategie erfolgreich weiterentwickelt. Du konzipierst und optimierst KI-gestützte Prozesse für die Erstellung von Text-, Bild- und Video-Content und setzt sie für Website- und Advertorial-Texte, Newsletter sowie reichweitenstarke Social-Media-Inhalte ein. Unterstütze uns dabei, die bereits heute weltweit führende Probiotika-Marke Kijimea durch intelligente, effiziente und wirkungsvolle Content-Prozesse noch erfolgreicher zu machen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere AI-first-Strategie für die Content-Erstellung und führst KI-gestützte Prozesse von der Idee bis zur skalierbaren Umsetzung ein.

  • Du identifizierst geeignete KI-Anwendungsfälle entlang des gesamten Content-Prozesses – von Themenfindung und Recherche über Texterstellung und Variantenbildung bis hin zu Qualitätssicherung, Aufbereitung und Distribution.

  • Du setzt generative KI für die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Text-, Bild- und Video-Content ein und entwickelst Standards für den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in der Gesundheitskommunikation.

  • Du konzipierst, testest und optimierst Prompts, Prompt-Bibliotheken, KI-Workflows und spezialisierte KI-Agents, um hochwertige Inhalte effizienter, konsistenter und skalierbarer zu produzieren.

  • Du entwickelst qualitativ hochwertige, zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Websites, Content-Plattformen, Shops, E-Mail-Newsletter und Social Media – mit KI als zentralem Produktions- und Optimierungswerk-zeug.

  • Du verantwortest die Bildrecherche und Bildgenerierung und stellst sicher, dass visuelle Inhalte zur jeweiligen Plattform, Zielgruppe und Kommunikationsstrategie passen.

  • Du überwachst und analysierst die Performance unserer Inhalte und Kampagnen, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab und optimierst Content auf Basis relevanter Kennzahlen.

  • Du beobachtest Entwicklungen im Bereich generativer KI, bewertest neue Tools und Technologien und leitest daraus konkrete Empfehlungen für unsere Content-Produktion ab.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Kommunikation, Journalismus, Medien, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Du bringst mind. 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Content Marketing, in der Redaktion, im Copywriting, in der Unternehmenskommunikation mit – idealerweise im Gesundheitsbereich oder Konsumgüterindustrie.

  • Du hast bereits intensiv mit generativer KI gearbeitet und verstehst, wie KI-Tools sinnvoll, verantwortungsvoll und qualitätsgesichert in professionelle Content-Prozesse integriert werden.

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Prompts und hast idealerweise bereits KI-gestützte Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Agents konzipiert und umgesetzt.

  • Du bringst Interesse an (wissenschaftlichen) Gesundheitsthemen eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe mit.

  • Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen, digitale Kanäle und die Anforderungen an Content entlang der Customer Journey.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Beurteilung von Bild-, Video- und weiteren multimedialen Content-Formaten mit.
