jobs.title: Deployment Strategist | DE
jobs.description:
Deployment Strategist | DE

Who we are

At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.

Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.

That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.

Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai.

Your role

supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering.

As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next.

You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization.

Each account is led by a two-person leadership pair consisting of an AI Strategist and a Deployment Strategist. Together, you run the account end-to-end. You work directly with the customer and own the relationship end-to-end.

You also work closely with two Forward Deployed Engineers, forming a four-person delivery unit responsible for execution inside the account.

This role suits someone who moves comfortably through ambiguity, leads complex enterprise engagements and connects AI capabilities to operational reality.

What you own

  • Delivery of committed outcomes, with AI systems running reliably in production

  • Day-to-day stakeholder trust and executive alignment

  • Technical solution design across deployed AI systems

  • Execution quality alongside Forward Deployed Engineers

  • Deployment and adaptation of supermodular’s internal playbooks and platforms

  • Identifying and shaping expansion opportunities within the account

  • Translating organizational problems into prioritized, executable AI initiatives

What you bring

  • You have 8+ years in complex software environments as an engineer, product manager or engineering manager, working across the full product development lifecycle from discovery to production.

  • You think strategically. You connect AI capabilities to what the organization is trying to achieve and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed.

  • You are curious and AI-first. You follow how models, agents and tooling evolve, and you understand where they create practical enterprise value and what it takes to run them reliably: evaluation, observability, safety.

  • You are a pragmatic, lean thinker. You have the technical depth to guide solution design, look for the simplest solution that works and make clear trade-offs.

  • You take the shortest route to impact. You find another way when the usual path is slow, work with what is available, and get results in front of the client early.

  • You work autonomously. You take ownership of the account, use sound operational judgment and carry decisions through to results.

  • You focus on business impact. You start from the outcome the organization needs and measure your work by the operational change it creates.

  • You are a systems thinker. You see how models, workflows, tooling, data and people connect across an enterprise landscape.

  • You are an excellent project manager. You set priorities, plan the work, keep commitments visible and deliver what the account has agreed to.

  • You negotiate well. You align stakeholders with different interests, agree scope and commitments, and keep the engagement focused on the outcomes that matter.

  • You are a strong storyteller. You frame a problem so executives want to act on it, make the business case for each initiative, and grow the account by showing what the next step is worth.

  • You lead through the team. You give Forward Deployed Engineers clear direction and room to build, make decisions together with your AI Strategist, and step in wherever the account needs you.

  • You have a bias to action. You turn discussions into next steps, keep work moving every day and follow through until it runs in production.

Recruiter Screen > Experience > Client Project > Offer

Unser Kunde

Das Kerngeschäft: End-to-End-Entwicklung, Design, eigene Serienfertigung und Realisierung von Micro-Living, Serviced Apartments und Hospitality-Interieurs – inklusive eigener Möbelproduktion. Mehrfach preisgekrönt (3× German Design Award 2025), wirtschaftlich stabil, langfristige Projektpipeline.
Das Umfeld ist kreativ, lösungsorientiert und stark von Umsetzung geprägt. Keine endlosen Strategierunden ohne Ergebnis, sondern Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge wirklich voranbringen. Die Kultur ist familiär, flach hierarchisch, wertschätzend – mit einem top ausgestatteten Altbaubüro an der Isar und 4,5-Sterne-Kununu-Rating. Und genau hier wird jetzt ein Teamlead gesucht, der Projektleiter führt, Projekte strategisch steuert und Prozesse optimiert.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Überschaubare Workload (2–3 Projekte gleichzeitig), planbare Reisetätigkeit (ca. 20 Tage/Jahr)

Aufgaben

  • Strukturierte Steuerung von Änderungen und Nachträgen – Bewertung von Kosten- und Terminwirkungen, fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen

Qualifikation

  • Sicheres Auftreten auf Kunden- und Managementebene – du repräsentierst das Unternehmen, verhandelst, überzeugst

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für Prozessoptimierungen und Kostensteuerung – du denkst in Effizienz, nicht nur in Ausführung

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • 4,5-Sterne-Kununu-Rating

  • Unterstützung bei Wohnungssuche für Umzugsbereite

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du baust nicht nur Projekte, sondern ein Team, Prozesse und die Zukunft eines familiengeführten Design & Build-Unternehmens – mit preisgekröntem Design

  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit und direkter Einfluss auf Geschäftsführung und Kunden – keine anonyme Konzernstruktur

  • Bestehendes Potential ist bereits da – 30 Mitarbeitende, eigene Serienfertigung, German Design Award 2025 – jetzt braucht es jemanden, der die Projektleitung auf das nächste Level hebt

This is not a product management role, and it is not a frontend role. You will spend your time in discovery and in the codebase, shipping proofs of concept and MVPs that prove out whether an idea deserves to become part of the core product. Our core product is our agents, our harness, and the agentic workflows that run on them, so this is deep systems and AI work.

This role reports to the Head of Product and sits alongside our platform engineering team. If you would rather own the long-term architecture and scaling of the core platform than chase new product bets, look at our Staff/Principal Software Engineer opening instead.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full arc of a product bet: research and discovery, customer and data analysis, scoping, then building the proof of concept or MVP yourself.

  • Make the call on what to build, what to cut, and what to kill, backed by evidence rather than opinion.

  • Hand off proven prototypes to the platform engineering team, or productionize them yourself when that's the faster path.

  • Set the bar for how we evaluate agent quality: evals, instrumentation, and the metrics that tell us whether something actually works.

Who we are

At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.

Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.

That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.

Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai.

Your role

As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next.

You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization.

Proposition de stage de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur « Chargé(e) d'études physico-chimiques pour la dépollution des eaux par une technologie piézocatalytique»

Unité : CERI Matériaux et Procédés

Responsables : Cédric SAMUEL

Catégorie : Stagiaire de Master 2 ou de fin d’études ingénieur (6 mois)

Lieu de travail : Douai – Lahure

 

Contexte :

École sous tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, et école de l’Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

 

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants :

  • Systèmes Numériques

  • Energie Environnement

  • Matériaux et Procédés

 

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr.

 

 

Contexte :

Le projet DEFI-PIEZOCAT, soutenu par l'IMT Nord Europe et la Région Hauts-de-France, développe une technologie de rupture pour le traitement des micropolluants de l'eau (notamment les PFAS et résidus de pesticides). En rupture avec les méthodes classiques de captation (charbon actif), notre approche vise la destruction active des polluants grâce à un procédé inédit de piézocatalyse, utilisant des matériaux électroactifs 100 % biosourcés et sans fluor. Ce projet à fort potentiel de transfert technologique vise la création prochaine d'une start-up Deeptech.

 

Vos missions :

Au sein de l'équipe projet, vous prendrez en charge le volet analytique visant à prouver et quantifier l'efficacité de notre technologie. Votre rôle sera centré sur la chimie analytique et la validation des performances :

·         Mettre au point et optimiser les protocoles de dosage des polluants modèles (colorants type Bleu de Méthylène, Rhodamine B) et des cibles réelles (pesticides, PFAS) dans des matrices aqueuses.

·         Réaliser le suivi analytique des campagnes d'essais sur des montages basiques (prélèvements, préparation d'échantillons, analyses instrumentales).

·         Mener les études cinétiques de dégradation et comparer les résultats avec les expériences témoins (tests d'adsorption à blanc, matériaux inertes).

·         Identifier et caractériser les éventuels sous-produits de dégradation pour valider l'innocuité du traitement.

·         Participer à l'interprétation des données et à la rédaction des rapports techniques qui viendront appuyer la stratégie de Propriété Intellectuelle.


Profil du candidat/de la candidate :

  • Étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou dernière année d'École d'Ingénieurs, spécialisation en Chimie Analytique, Mesures Physiques ou Traitement des Eaux.

  • Solides compétences pratiques en techniques d'analyses physico-chimiques (Spectrophotométrie UV-Vis, FTIR et idéalement chromatographie liquide type HPLC / LC-MS).

  • Rigueur scientifique absolue, esprit de synthèse et goût prononcé pour le travail expérimental en laboratoire.

  • Un intérêt pour l'innovation environnementale et l'écosystème Deeptech/Start-up est un grand plus.

Conditions :

Ce stage sera réalisé majoritairement à l'IMT Nord Europe (site de Douai) au Centre d’Enseignement de Recherche et d’Innovation « Matériaux & Procédés » (CERI MP). Des déplacements sont prévus au sein de la région pour analyses complémentaires.

 

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

 

  •          Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à Dr. Cédric SAMUEL – Tél. 03 27 71 24 43 – E-mail :

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.

jobs.title: Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy
jobs.description:
Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy

0.8 – 1 fte week | Utrecht | Hybride | Hbo/wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy. Ben jij een expert op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en privacy en combineer je inhoudelijke kennis met een pragmatische aanpak? En wil je samen met collega’s bouwen aan een verantwoorde balans tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en het benutten van kansen die de snelle ontwikkeling in automatisering en AI bieden? Dan zoeken wij jou.

Dit ga je doen

Als Coördinator Informatiebeveiliging & Privacy zorg je ervoor dat informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot niet alleen goed zijn geregeld op papier, maar vooral ook in de praktijk. Je vertaalt beleid, risico’s en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen en helpt collega’s om deze toe te passen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Information Security & Privacy Officer (ISO/PO), de Functionaris Gegevensbescherming (FG), IT en verschillende teams binnen Berenschot. Vanuit jouw rol houd je overzicht, coördineer je verbeteracties en steek je zelf de handen uit de mouwen. Je bent dus niet alleen adviserend bezig, maar zorgt er ook voor dat zaken daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Je bevordert het bewustzijn en de kennis van informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen de organisatie en ondersteunt bij incidenten, risicoanalyses en assessments.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het informatiebeveiligings- en privacybeleid en de vertaling hiervan naar praktische afspraken en acties.

  • Periodiek rapporteren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy aan de directie en het management, met concrete aandachtspunten en voorstellen voor verbetering.

  • Het signaleren en beoordelen van risico’s en het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en DPIA’s samen met collega’s.

  • Het onderhouden en verder verbeteren van het Information Security Management System (ISMS) en daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van onder andere de AVG, NIS2 en ISO 27001.

  • Het coördineren van verbeteracties en ondersteunen bij informatiebeveiligingsincidenten en datalekken.

  • Het vergroten van bewustzijn binnen de organisatie en collega’s praktisch adviseren over informatiebeveiliging en privacy.

  • De rol biedt nadrukkelijk ruimte om te groeien. Naarmate je de organisatie en het vakgebied beter leert kennen, pak je steeds meer regie en ontwikkel je je verder van een praktisch en coördinerende rol naar een meer tactische en strategische adviesrol.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je korte lijnen hebt met collega’s en de ruimte krijgt om verbeteringen voor te stellen en op te pakken.


Dit neem je mee

Je hebt een stevige basis in informatiebeveiliging en privacy en vindt het leuk om zaken daadwerkelijk voor elkaar te krijgen. Je kunt beleid en risico’s vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en voelt je prettig in een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Tegelijkertijd heb je de ambitie om je verder te ontwikkelen en op termijn ook meer strategische verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarbij neem je mee:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau; bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van securitymanagement, bestuurskunde of bedrijfskunde.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring en relevante ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging en/of privacy.

  • Kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en normenkaders, zoals de AVG, BIO, ABRO, NIS2, NEN7510 en ISO 27001.

  • Het vermogen om risico’s en beleid te vertalen naar concrete, werkbare maatregelen en acties.

  • Een praktische en zelfstandige houding: je adviseert, organiseert én pakt zelf zaken op.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatiesensitiviteit, waardoor je collega’s kunt meenemen en verschillende belangen bij elkaar kunt brengen.

Certificeringen als CISSP, CISM, CISA, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPM en CDPO zijn een pré, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker vinden we dat je de inhoudelijke basis en motivatie hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

In deze functie krijg je ruimte om samen met collega’s de het information- & securitybeleid verder vorm te geven en je inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Zo bouw je mee aan de informatiebeveiliging en privacy binnen Berenschot én aan je eigen volgende stap.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk marktconform salaris afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • Vakantiegeld; 8% over het brutosalaris.

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • een NS businesscard of kilometervergoeding van € 0.25 cent per km

  • thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,35 per dag

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij een trotse Berenschotter worden en samen met collega’s de informatiebeveiliging en privacy bij Berenschot verder brengen? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via WhatsApp, e-mail () of telefoon (06-25722612), of met Katinka van Dongen ( of 06-51 30 07 01).

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega’s en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om ons assessment te doen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

jobs.description:
Strategist, Agent Development (Dutch speaking)

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

jobs.title: Senior Search and Conversion Writer
jobs.description:
Senior Search and Conversion Writer

Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Every Interrail trip starts with a question: "Where should I go in October?", "Can I see the Alps by train?", "How does the Pass actually work?". We're looking for someone who will make sure Interrail is the best answer, wherever it's asked: Google, AI assistants or a paid search ad.

 

You'll write the guides, itineraries and how-tos that bring travellers to us, and the search ads and landing pages that turn their curiosity into a Pass. Most of your time (around 70%) goes into organic and AI search content. The rest goes into paid search copy and landing pages, where the two worlds meet.

 

You'll sit in our Creatives & Content team and work day-to-day with our SEO Specialist, Paid Media, CRO, CRM and UX colleagues.

 

Also, it's good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, therefore you will be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Creatives and Content team, a friendly group of writers, designers, videographers, content managers and other creatives, and reporting to our Managing Editor.

You’ll be involved in:

 

Organic and AI search content

  • Turn our SEO and GEO keyword and topic strategy into an editorial plan, from inspirational queries ("underrated Greek islands") to high-intent ones ("how to plan an Interrail trip").

  • Use customer research, on-site search and questions shared with Customer Service to identify content gaps, understand traveller concerns and improve how we explain the Pass.

  • Write and edit destination guides, route pages, itineraries, how-tos and Pass explainers that rank, get cited by AI assistants and move readers closer to travelling.  Publish content months ahead of demand peaks. 

  • Work with internal experts, rail partners and travellers to develop first-hand advice, practical examples and original stories that give people a reason to choose Interrail content.

  • Balance the obvious mobility topics (routes, destinations, practical planning) with consideration of our purpose and belief in The Interrail Effect: how travelling Europe with a rail Pass way changes how you see the world, and why only Interrail can say it.

  • Structure content so both people and machines can use it: answer-first paragraphs, clear heading hierarchy, FAQs, factual and quotable answers for AI Overviews and assistants.

  • Own on-page copy (titles, meta descriptions, slugs, alt text, internal anchors) and brief schema needs to the Senior SEO & GEO Manager.

  • Refresh, consolidate or retire decaying and overlapping pages, using the audits run with the Senior SEO & GEO Manager.

  • Verify routes, reservation requirements, Pass conditions and other practical details with the relevant teams, and keep published advice up to date.

Conversion copy

  • Write paid search copy (Google and Microsoft responsive search ads, Performance Max text assets) built on the same search intent as our organic content.

  • Write landing pages that serve paid and organic traffic, keeping ad, page and offer in one consistent message, and supply copy variants for tests run by CRO and Paid Media.

Collaboration and ways of working

  • Make editorial recommendations about what to create, improve, combine or stop, balancing customer needs, commercial value and available capacity.

  • Create the search message framework (core value propositions, proof points, tone by journey stage) that campaign copywriters use for paid social, display and CRM.

  • Review content performance and copy-test results with SEO, Paid Media and CRO, and apply the findings to future briefs, messaging and updates.

  • Use AI tools to speed up research, outlines and ad variants, while owning accuracy, voice and the human perspective in everything published.

  • Develop a keen understanding of the Interrail brand and The Interrail Effect, embedding it into all SEO, SEA and GEO efforts. Optimise content for search while reinforcing our purpose. 

What success looks like

After 6 months

  • Priority topic clusters for the next two seasonal peaks are planned, written and/or refreshed, and live ahead of demand.

  • A shared search message framework is in use by Paid Media and the campaign copywriters.

  • A baseline for AI-search visibility (citations in AI Overviews and assistants for priority queries) is set with the Senior SEO & GEO Manager.

 

After 12 months

  • Measurable growth in organic sessions and Pass conversions from content in priority clusters [targets to be set with Growth team].

  • Improved AI-search visibility for priority queries against the baseline.

  • Measurable lift in paid search CTR and landing page conversion from copy tests [targets to be set with Paid Media and CRO].  

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

 

Must-haves

  • 6+ years writing SEO content, with organic growth you can show on a large, content-led site.

  • A portfolio with both long-form search content and paid search ads, plus the results behind them.

  • Strong grasp of search intent, topic clusters, on-page SEO, E-E-A-T and content refresh strategy.

  • Experience adapting content for AI search, with a clear approach to testing, evaluating results and applying what you learn.

  • Experience writing within ad platform limits and learning from copy tests.

  • Understanding of how to leverage AI responsibly and efficiently in the context of a role like this one.

  • Range: Ability to go from writing an evocative destination story to a 30-character headline in the same afternoon, in flawless English.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams (including with fellow creatives, paid channel owners and beyond) while owning individual impact.

  • Strong editorial judgement: you can identify a useful angle, substantiate it and write in a distinctive brand voice without relying on clichés or generic travel language.

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in travel, hospitality or lifestyle industry

  • Experience with Semrush or Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Ads.

  • Experience writing for multiple markets or briefing localisation. 

  • Fluency in one or more of our main market languages, such as Dutch or German

  • Experience exploring Europe by train  

 

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary scale 59: Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €4,400 – €5,500 (full-time), based on experience.

 

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

Staff Business Systems Engineer – Tax Technology

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Business Systems Engineer – Tax Technology to lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, and optimization of our global tax technology landscape. This role will serve as the technical leader for tax platforms, partnering closely with Tax, Finance, Accounting, IT Engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, compliant, and automated tax solutions that support CoreWeave's rapid global growth.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in multiple tax engines (Vertex, Avalara, 1Source etc.), with strong indirect tax domain knowledge, and hands-on experience integrating tax platforms with ERP, billing, procurement, and enterprise applications. This individual will drive the modernization of tax technology while ensuring compliance, operational efficiency, and enterprise scalability.

  • Lead the architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of tax solutions across global operations.

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

jobs.description:
Director, Enterprise Sales Field Operations, Americas

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

The Director of AMER Enterprise Sales Field Operations is the primary operations partner to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales. You will own the operating rhythm of the region: forecasting, pipeline generation and inspection, and business reviews. You will also shape the region's go-to-market strategy, expansion plans, and capacity model. In this role, you will act as the COO to the VP of AMER Enterprise Sales, ensuring our business is growing efficiently and effectively. You need to think strategically about the Enterprise business, understanding the implications of changing market and team dynamics and proactively developing solutions that enable us to win.

You will lead a team of three field operations managers and analysts. Success in this role means a more accurate forecast, a healthier pipeline, measurable gains in rep productivity, and increasing ARR across AMER Enterprise. The work you do will shape how Fivetran grows in the Americas.

This role sits within the GTM Strategy and Operations organization.

What You’ll Do

Forecasting and pipeline

  • Own the AMER Enterprise forecast process, including call methodology, roll-up, and accuracy tracking against commit and best case, giving leadership a number they can commit to with confidence.

  • Drive pipeline generation planning: with the marketing, partner, and sales leadership teams set coverage targets by segment and source, track progress, and flag gaps early enough to act, so each quarter starts with the pipeline needed to hit plan.

  • Run pipeline inspection with sales leadership, focusing on deal quality, stage progression, and slippage, so risk surfaces while there is still time to save the deal.

Operating cadence and performance management

  • Design and run the region's operating cadence: weekly forecast calls, pipeline reviews, monthly business reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Continuously refine those cadences so they drive decisions rather than reporting.

  • Run AE performance reviews with frontline and second-line managers, using consistent metrics to identify coaching needs and performance risk, so managers act on facts rather than anecdotes.

  • Identify and prioritize the metrics the field uses to run the business, and partner with GTM Analytics to build and maintain the supporting dashboards, giving every leader in the region a shared view of performance.

  • Lead deep-dive investigations into performance questions, and turn findings into specific recommendations that change how the region sells.

Regional strategy

  • Shape GTM strategy and org structure for AMER Enterprise by region and sales motion, setting the team up to win as enterprise AI demand grows.

  • Build the analysis behind regional expansion decisions, such as which territories to enter next and in what sequence, so we invest where the opportunity is largest.

  • Design region- and motion-specific SPIFFs, then measure whether they changed behavior and results.

Annual planning and capacity (in partnership with Strategy and Planning)

  • Support quota setting for the region, bringing field context to top-down targets so quotas are both ambitious and attainable.

  • Support and refine territory carving so territories are balanced and match the coverage model.

  • Pressure-test assumptions in the bottoms-up headcount model and coverage ratios, so hiring plans reflect real field performance.

  • Validate rep productivity and ramp assumptions against actual performance data.

Team leadership

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of field operations managers and analysts and grow them into strategic partners to sales leadership.

  • Set clear priorities for the team and allocate its capacity against the needs of AMER Enterprise leadership.

Who you'll work with

  • VP of AMER Enterprise Sales and their leadership team: your primary stakeholders and day-to-day partners.

  • Strategy and Planning: annual plan, quota, territory, and capacity modeling.

  • Revenue Operations: CRM, systems, process, and data integrity.

  • GTM Analytics: dashboards, reporting, and analytical deep dives.

  • Enablement: onboarding, ramp, and skill gaps surfaced through performance reviews.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in sales operations, sales strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical role, including 4+ years supporting enterprise sales teams directly.

  • 4+ years managing people, ideally analysts or operations managers.

  • Track record of owning a forecast process and improving its accuracy.

  • Experience running sales operating cadences and business reviews with senior sales leaders.

  • Working knowledge of annual planning: quota setting, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and ramp assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills, including building models in spreadsheets and working with CRM and BI data (for example, Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, or SQL).

  • Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and defend it with sales leaders.

Bonus Skills​

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with a consumption-based or usage-based pricing model.

  • Experience designing sales incentive programs or SPIFFs.

  • Experience supporting regional expansion or new-segment launches.

  • Prior experience as the dedicated operations partner to a regional sales leader.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

jobs.title: Manager Amazon
jobs.description:
Manager Amazon

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Manager Amazon verantwortest Du unseren Amazon-Vertriebskanal ganzheitlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Healthcare-Produkte sichtbar, verfügbar und erfolgreich sind. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu ermöglichen.

jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer, Agents (Python) (f/m/d)

Bliro:

  • The AI assistant for field sales

  • Takes desk work off sales reps' plates entirely, with more than one million customer touchpoints documented

  • Trusted by lighthouses of the German Mittelstand like igus, Lanxess and Brillux

  • Backed by 468 Capital, Lea Partners, Rockstart and more, with over €3M raised

  • See Bliro in action: https://bliro.io

Why We're Hiring This Role:

  • Our chat agent and our voice to voice phone agent process and document thousands of customer interactions a week for field sales teams. Every answer has to be right, fast and useful on the road.

  • Our backend engineers build the platform. We need a senior AI engineer who owns agent quality: what the agents say, how well they say it, and how we prove they got better.

  • You'll own prompting and context, model benchmarking for our use cases, evals, and the agent harness behind both agents. You join a small team of high performing specialists who own the core of our agents. This role is about orchestrating and evaluating models, not training them.

What You'll Do:

  • 30 Days: Map Bliro's chat and voice agents end to end. Partner with the backend engineers, review real user conversations, identify the biggest failure modes, and ship an initial improvement.

  • 60 Days: Own agent quality measurement. Build eval sets and metrics for our key use cases, benchmark models on quality, latency and cost, and ship a change with a measurable improvement against the baseline.

  • 90 Days: Establish a repeatable model for improving agent quality. Run evals on every prompt, model and harness change, turn real conversations into new test cases automatically, and set the longer term roadmap for agent quality.

Who You Are:

  • Evidence of ownership and shipping LLM agents to real users and proving with data that they got better. You can demonstrate excellence and pursued a technical major at one of the major technical universities like TUM, ETH, KIT, RWTH, EPFL, etc.

  • Strong Python and the ability to debug agent behavior across prompts, tools, context and model choice.

  • Hands on experience building eval pipelines, LLM judges and model benchmarks, with enough statistics to tell a real gain from noise.

  • You ground your decisions in real user data, using AI to help analyze them, and turn what you find into test cases, fixes and clear priorities.

  • Deep curiosity and the ability to gather context quickly, form a clear point of view, and keep pace as models and the product evolve.

  • A low ego teammate who communicates clearly and owns outcomes. Familiarity with AI coding tools is expected; experience with the latest agent frameworks, realtime voice agents and multilingual agents is a plus.

  • This is a full time role. We prefer hybrid in Munich but are open to remote.

How We Work:

  • Ambition: We get better every day by being curious and bold.

  • Continuous improvement: Move fast and break things, but never the same thing twice.

  • It's our problem: We operate as one team. We share credit, own mistakes together, and support each other when things get hard.

  • Why not today? We value urgency and momentum. The fastest path to customer value usually wins.

  • Build something worthy of love: Craft matters. We aim to build products customers genuinely love.

Why Bliro:

  • Generational impact: Build the human interface for millions of field sellers

  • Ownership culture: Many of us are former founders

  • Forward thinkers: We are the world leader in privacy preserving transcription, we know how boundaries can be overcome

What We Offer:

Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)

Wir öffnen eine neue, zentrale Position in unserem Team: eine Person, die Recruiting nicht als Aufgabe, sondern als Handwerk und Hebel für Unternehmenserfolg versteht. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

jobs.title: Back End Developer (Java)
jobs.description:
Back End Developer (Java)

Location: London or Ipswich, UK (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time

About Mach:

MACH is Delta Capita's proprietary Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) and workflow orchestration platform, developed to help financial institutions modernise post-trade, collateral, regulatory and operational processes. As part of Delta Capita's Technology & Solutions business, MACH combines blockchain, workflow automation and enterprise integration capabilities to deliver scalable solutions to global financial services clients.

Job Description:

 As a Back End Developer at MACH, you will be instrumental in designing and implementing the backend architecture for blockchain and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) solutions aimed at financial services clients. Working closely with blockchain architects, front-end developers, and other stakeholders, you will develop secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems that enable seamless integration with MACH’s cutting-edge solutions. Expertise in backend development, API design, and blockchain technologies will be critical to your success.

 

Responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust backend systems for MACH’s blockchain/DLT solutions.

  • Build and optimise APIs, microservices, and other system integrations to support workflow orchestration, front-end applications and blockchain interactions.

  • Work closely with blockchain architects to implement smart contract integration and other blockchain-specific backend components.

  • Ensure backend systems meet performance, scalability, and security requirements.

  • Develop database schemas, manage migrations, and optimise queries for efficient data storage and retrieval.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve backend issues to maintain system reliability.

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline development workflows.

  • Stay informed about emerging trends in backend and blockchain development to ensure MACH remains at the forefront of innovation.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless user experience and end-to-end system functionality.

  • Document technical specifications, processes, and system designs to maintain clear and comprehensive records.


 As an experienced Back End Developer, you will have:

  • Strong experience in backend Java development.

  • Proficiency in developing and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.

  • Experience working with databases and optimising query performance.

  • Familiarity with authentication, encryption, and other security practices for backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience with containerisation tools (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex backend issues.

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in cross-functional teams.

  • A proactive mindset with the ability to deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable:

  • Understanding of blockchain/DLT platforms (e.g., Ethereum, Hyperledger, or Corda) and their backend integration.

  • Hands-on experience with blockchain-specific backend frameworks or libraries (e.g., Web3j).

  • Familiarity with financial services applications and industry requirements.

  • Experience in implementing event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools for infrastructure automation and monitoring.

  • Understanding of Agile development methodologies and best practices.

  • Experience with Camunda and Activiti

 

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please inform us.

This is a permanent full-time position with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks.

 

Who We Are:

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - German Speaking
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative - German Speaking

About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

As a core member of our Sales team, you’ll connect with a wide range of prospects and spark their interest in our authentication tech. You’ll be on the front lines of our growth engine, partnering with AEs and other BDRs to uncover opportunities, start meaningful conversations, fuel a steady pipeline of qualified leads, and own the full lifecycle for smaller deals.

What you'll do

As a Business Development Representative, you’ll focus on getting companies excited about our product. You’ll be reaching out to prospects across every level - from procurement managers and lead engineers to heads of anti-fraud, platform owners, CTOs, CPOs, and even CEOs. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Generating new sales opportunities for Prelude

  • Identifying companies and people to target within your verticals/territories

  • Cold calling and emailing as well as experimenting with other channels to find new leads

  • Qualifying leads and pitching Prelude's value proposition

  • Closing smaller deals independently

  • Maintaining a clean CRM

  • Improving processes as we scale our business

About you:

  • You have 6 months to 1 year of BDR or sales experience, ideally selling a technical product at a startup, scale-up, or SaaS company

  • You can handle the friction and challenges of cold calling and outbound prospecting

  • Solid understanding of qualification fundamentals

  • Able to understand technical concepts and translate them into business terms

  • A proactive mindset, with a drive to start conversations, build momentum, and close deals

  • Structured and rigorous in managing your pipeline, CRM hygiene, and performance metrics

  • You know your way around HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Apollo, RingOver, or Kaspr

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, taking initiative and finding solutions

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an excellent team player

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn by doing

  • Fluency in selling a technical product in German

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package (base + uncapped commission)

  • Comprehensive health insurance plan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • 100% transport subsidised

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Pet-friendly office environment

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

  • Laptop and equipment needed to do the role

  • Hybrid working style: 4 days at the office and 1 day at home, with 4 weeks of remote working per year

jobs.description:
Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering | Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijkrelaties

Omschrijving

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering voor O&P Rijk, de hr-dienstverlener voor de Rijksoverheid. O&P Rijk is in 2023 ontstaan uit de samenvoeging van UBR Personeel, P-Direkt en Binnenwerk en biedt dienstverlening op het gebied van organisatie en personeel.

In 2026 heeft O&P Rijk de financiële functie laten doorlichten. Deze doorlichting geeft richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling van financiële processen, rapportages, interne beheersing en de inrichting van de organisatie. Als Senior Adviseur Financiële Bedrijfsvoering lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan deze doorontwikkeling en werk je binnen verschillende financiële werkstromen.

Je verzamelt, structureert en analyseert financiële en bedrijfskundige informatie en vertaalt deze naar verbetervoorstellen, rapportages en beslisdocumenten. Daarbij breng je samenhang, voortgang, afhankelijkheden, risico’s en knelpunten tussen de verschillende werkstromen in beeld.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verzamelt, ordent en analyseert financiële en bedrijfskundige informatie.

  • Je brengt informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen tot een integraal beeld en maakt onderlinge afhankelijkheden en raakvlakken inzichtelijk.

  • Je analyseert de voortgang en afwijkingen binnen de financiële werkstromen en signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden.

  • Je bereidt voorstellen voor en onderbouwt deze voor besluitvorming door de projectmanager en CFO.

Wat vragen wij?

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je bent in staat financiële en bedrijfskundige vraagstukken op strategisch niveau te analyseren en te vertalen naar concrete voorstellen.

  • Je bent in staat informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen te brengen tot een helder totaalbeeld.

  • Je werkt analytisch, accuraat en gestructureerd en kan schakelen tussen verschillende financiële vraagstukken.
