jobs.title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
jobs.description:
Principal AI & Automation Lead

AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken.

Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

  • Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

  • Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

  • Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

  • Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

  • Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

  • Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.


We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

  • De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

  • Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen.

  • Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen.

  • Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

  • Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript.

  • Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies.

  • Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening.

Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken.

Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren.

We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen.

We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag. Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Internet-, telefonie- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • €750 per jaar voor boeken, workshops, seminars of andere dingen die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Een aanvullend studiebudget van €2.500 per jaar.

  • Een vast aantal studie-uren per jaar, zodat je ook daadwerkelijk tijd kunt besteden aan je ontwikkeling.

  • €550 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek.

  • Onze participatieregeling Good Shares, waarmee je mede-eigenaar kunt worden van de organisatie.

  • Een pensioenbijdrage van 5,3%, volledig door ons betaald.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en een NS-Business Card. Ons kantoor zit pal naast station Almere Centraal.

  • En verschillende extra's, zoals stoelmassages, vers bereide (warme) lunches op kantoor en korting op je sportabonnement.

Enthousiast?

Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van mogelijkheden, het bouwen van slimme oplossingen en het helpen van anderen om technologie écht te benutten?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. Dat mag vanuit je werkervaring zijn, maar ook vanuit eigen projecten of andere initiatieven.

Wat zijn je taken?

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
System Engineer

About Invisix

Semiconductor manufacturers can't build what they can't measure. Invisix Measuring Systems is a fast-growing scale-up in the high-tech industry, developing next-generation metrology solutions for the semiconductor sector. We work at the intersection of optics, software, and data.

We're a small team, but the depth of knowledge inside Invisix is anything but small. Our culture is professional and fast-paced, with short communication lines and a strong sense of shared purpose. Everyone here is committed, and everyone knows their work directly contributes to something bigger.

The Role

We're looking for a System Engineer to make our metrology equipment work to spec in a real program: requirements, error budgets, integration and verification, and system-level problem solving amongst others.

Reporting to our CTO, you take a program or release of our product, or a subsystem of it, from requirements to a tool that passes customer acceptance and ships on time. You work with our module and discipline engineers, integration, quality and service, and you're the technical contact for customers on specifications, acceptance criteria and escalations. Our system architect owns the concept; you make it work and prove it. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

Key Responsibilities

  • Break down system requirements into module requirements, and keep them traceable from customer need to test result

  • Own the detailed error budgets, and update them with measured data as the system matures

  • Write and maintain the interface control documents between modules, together with the module and discipline engineers

  • Set up integration, test, verification and qualification plans, and make sure the tool passes customer acceptance

  • Find the root cause of system-level problems across disciplines, and stay in contact with the factory and the field after shipment

  • Agree specifications and acceptance criteria with the system architect, handle technical escalations, and take on adjacent responsibilities as the company grows, such as system engineering for a next product release

Is this you?

  • MSc or PhD in physics, applied physics, mechatronics, electrical engineering or a related field, with at least 5 years of experience in system engineering for complex high-tech equipment

  • Experience in semiconductor equipment, for example lithography, metrology or inspection, or in comparable high-tech equipment

  • A solid physics background, especially in optics or measurement physics, so you can understand and quantify what limits system performance

  • Hands-on experience with requirements breakdown and traceability, error budgets, and integration, verification and qualification plans

  • Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE), for example with SysML

  • A rigorous, data-driven and systematic way of working, and enough depth in several disciplines to debug across them

  • Active use of AI tooling in your daily work (requirements analysis, data analysis, test reporting, documentation) to boost efficiency

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer acceptance and field escalations at semiconductor manufacturers

  • Experience with requirements management tools, such as Polarion or DOORS

  • Experience with statistical data analysis, for example in Python or MATLAB

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up

What We Offer

  • A role at the heart of our programs, taking our metrology equipment from requirements to customer acceptance, with real ownership from day one

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including an Employee Share Ownership Plan

  • A learning and development budget to support your growth

  • Flexible working arrangements, and room to grow into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales

Interested?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd like to hear from you, even if you only recognize yourself in part of this description. Submit your resume, and let's find out together if there's a match.

If this isn't quite the right position for you but you're still interested in Invisix, reach out to us at ----- style="color:#1F4E79">Diversity & Inclusion

We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, where ideas and individuals flourish. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and judge candidates on merit and potential contribution, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or other identity characteristics. What we're looking for is talent with integrity, a collaborative mindset, and a drive to make an impact.

Your Data

Your application data is processed by Invisix and kept in our applicant tracking system so we can consider you for this role and future opportunities. See our privacy policy for details: invisix.com/privacybeleid/

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

jobs.description:
Associate Counsel, Vendor and Provider Contracting

Clover Health’s legal team is a group of proactive business partners whose mission is to empower the organization to innovate and achieve its goals within a dynamic and fluid regulatory environment. We are committed to supporting continued excellence for our customers while building a sustainable future for the organization. We believe integrity, collaboration, and sustainability ensures Clover Health exceeds its objectives, while upholding the highest standards of legal and ethical responsibility.

Clover is looking for an attorney with three to five years of experience to join our Legal team and support vendor and healthcare provider contracting. As Associate Counsel, you will independently draft, review, negotiate, and manage agreements that enable Clover’s health plan, clinical, technology, and corporate operations.

You will advise business teams throughout the vendor lifecycle—from initial evaluation and contracting through implementation, ongoing performance, renewal, and termination. You will help Clover establish commercial terms, protect sensitive information, address regulatory requirements, and develop practical solutions that support the company’s business objectives.

You will collaborate with stakeholders across Network, Clinical, Compliance, Procurement, Technology, Information Security, Privacy, Finance, and Operations. This role is well suited to an attorney who has meaningful contracting experience, exercises sound judgment, and is interested in developing deeper expertise at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and value-based care.

As an Associate Counsel, Vendor and Provider Contracting , you will:

Vendor and Commercial Contracting

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of vendor and commercial agreements, including master services agreements, statements of work, software licenses, professional and consulting services agreements, data-use and data-sharing agreements, nondisclosure agreements, business associate agreements, data protection addenda, order forms, and amendments.
  • Support agreements with vendors providing technology, cloud hosting, data analytics, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, clinical services, claims administration, member engagement, care management, provider data, credentialing, pharmacy-related services, utilization management, marketing, staffing, facilities, and other operational services.
  • Structure agreements to clearly define deliverables, implementation responsibilities, acceptance criteria, performance standards, service levels, pricing, invoicing, change-control procedures, and governance processes.
  • Evaluate and negotiate provisions concerning intellectual property ownership, licensing rights, data ownership and use, confidentiality, information security, privacy, artificial intelligence, subcontracting, insurance, indemnification, limitation of liability, audit rights, business continuity, disaster recovery, regulatory cooperation, and dispute resolution.
  • Advise business teams on contract renewals, pricing changes, scope expansions, performance issues, service-level failures, disputes, corrective-action plans, termination rights, transition assistance, and data return or destruction.
  • Partner with Privacy and Information Security teams to evaluate agreements involving protected health information, personally identifiable information, confidential business information, security reviews, incident notification, and vendor access to Clover systems or data.
  • Help address requirements applicable to Medicare Advantage vendors and first-tier, downstream, and related entities, including compliance obligations and cooperation with Clover’s vendor-oversight activities.
  • Identify business and legal risks during vendor selection and contract negotiations, clearly explain available options, and develop practical risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate with Procurement and business owners to promote consistent contracting practices and ensure that appropriate legal, compliance, privacy, security, financial, and operational reviews occur before execution.
  • Independently manage routine and moderately complex negotiations and escalate novel, high-risk, or strategically significant matters when appropriate.
  • Develop and improve vendor templates, clause libraries, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, approval standards, and contract-management processes.
  • Support contract intake, approvals, execution, recordkeeping, obligation tracking, renewals, amendments, and terminations.

Provider Contracting

  • Draft, review, and negotiate healthcare provider agreements, including participation agreements, amendments, value-based arrangements, and agreements with physician groups, facilities, ancillary providers, and other healthcare organizations.
  • Advise on provisions involving reimbursement, claims and payment, performance measures, quality standards, data exchange, credentialing, access, member protections, regulatory compliance, audit rights, records, and termination.
  • Collaborate with Network, Clinical, Operations, Compliance, and Finance teams to support provider relationships and contracting strategies.
  • Assist with resolving provider contract interpretation, performance, reimbursement, and operational issues.
  • Support the development and maintenance of provider agreement templates, amendments, and contracting guidance.

Legal Partnership and Operations

  • Provide timely, practical, and risk-based advice to internal business partners.
  • Conduct legal research concerning Medicare Advantage, managed care, healthcare contracting, privacy, technology, and general commercial matters.
  • Monitor assigned matters and communicate clearly and promptly with stakeholders and Legal team leadership.
  • Help create training materials and educate business teams about contracting requirements and effective vendor-management practices.
  • Support other Legal team priorities as Clover’s business evolves.

Success in this role looks like:

  • You approach legal questions with curiosity, care, and sound judgment.
  • You communicate complicated legal concepts in clear, practical language.
  • You can independently manage contract negotiations while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.
  • You understand that effective contracting requires attention to commercial, operational, regulatory, privacy, and security considerations.
  • You balance legal and regulatory risk with Clover’s operational and business objectives.
  • You are highly organized and can manage multiple agreements, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • You enjoy working collaboratively in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • You are motivated by Clover’s mission and interested in healthcare, technology, and improving outcomes for Medicare beneficiaries.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school.
  • You have active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • You have three to five years of relevant legal experience in a law firm, in-house legal department, government agency, or comparable setting.
  • You have experience independently drafting, reviewing, and negotiating vendor, commercial, or healthcare provider agreements.
  • You have demonstrated ability to identify contractual risks and propose practical solutions.
  • You have strong legal research, analytical, drafting, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • You have excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities with limited supervision.
  • You have authorization to practice in and work from the jurisdiction in which you will be employed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience working for or advising a health plan, health insurer, managed care organization, or other healthcare payer.
  • You have experience negotiating agreements with vendors supporting health plans or healthcare operations.
  • You have experience negotiating healthcare provider agreements, including participation, reimbursement, value-based care, facility, physician group, or ancillary provider agreements.
  • You have experience with technology, software, cloud services, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, professional services, or other complex vendor agreements.
  • You have familiarity with Medicare Advantage and the laws and regulations applicable to health plans, including CMS requirements, HIPAA, the federal Anti-Kickback Statute, and the Stark Law.
  • You have an understanding of health plan operations, provider networks, claims, reimbursement, delegated functions, utilization management, or vendor oversight.
  • You have familiarity with privacy, information-security, artificial-intelligence, or healthcare data issues.
  • You have experience using contract lifecycle management, matter-management, procurement, or electronic-signature platforms.

Candidates do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We encourage applications from thoughtful, motivated attorneys who are excited to grow with Clover.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer-centric Forward Deployed Engineer - DevOps/SRE to join our Customer Success team. In this role, you will play a crucial role as a technical solution expert and advisor working closely with some of the largest Harness AppSec customers to design, implement and optimize Harness platform and adoption strategies to ensure they realize maximum value and outcomes.

Our team is small, collaborative, and deeply motivated — we work at the intersection of technology, security, and business, and we bring curiosity and rigor to a wide range of challenges. You will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a rapidly growing company while helping customers harness the power of our AI-enabled DevSecOps platform to build and deliver software securely and efficiently — including protecting AI applications from emerging threats.

We prioritize psychological safety, mentorship, and continuous learning. Whether you're coming from engineering, architecture, consulting, or security — we want to hear from you.

About the role

  • Serve as the primary technical owner of customer implementations and adoption programs across the Harness AppSec portfolio, developing deep familiarity with each customer's environment, goals, and success criteria
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance and consulting to customers throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and implementation to adoption and value realization.
  • Develop strategic account success plans to ensure successful operationalization and value realization and drive alignment with all levels of customer leadership.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Harness platform and AppSec modules as well as general skillset across AI applications and security, DevOps, SecOps, application security, cloud architectures, networks and infrastructure disciplines and industry trends to effectively support, educate and advise customers.
  • Proactively analyze customer usage data to surface trends, adoption gaps, and optimization opportunities — delivering actionable recommendations across technology, process, and people dimensions.
  • Bring constructive feedback from customers to product management to improve the solution, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to drive the successful adoption, integration, and ongoing optimization of our solution.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and check-ins with customers to ensure their ongoing success and satisfaction, addressing any concerns or issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts by performing churn and adoption analysis to ensure target product adoption and business (AGRR) goals are met.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of customer success processes, tools, and resources to continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our customer success delivery methodologies and collateral.
  • Participate in Harness Community forums and help build reference architectures, best-practice guides, and enablement content

About you

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, security engineering, or technical account management within the software or technology industry.
  • 5+ years of experience with some multiple of the following solutions preferred:
    • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, CloudFormation, Linux
    • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, OpenShift, PCF
    • CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Harness Pipelines, Jira, ServiceNow.
    • Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, YAML, Go (a plus).
    • Application Security: SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST, SBOM generation, API security testing, pen testing fundamentals, SIEM (Splunk, Datadog), SOAR platforms.
  • Prior experience in security engineering and architecture, application security, API and AI security, development, DevOps, SecOps, or web security is preferred.
  • Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies and solutions in the AI, DevOps, Cloud and Security space.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to manage complex customer relationships and communicate business and technical value to all levels of management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering is preferred

Must Have Skills

  • Kubernetes eco system expertise (k8s, helm, release, upgrade, troubleshooting etc)
  • In depth Cloud experience - AWS is a must (GCP, Azure good to have) - infra provisioning, VPC++ ,EKS, S3, EBS ,EFS, EC2 etc
  • Linux ecosystem
  • Troubleshooting skills for the above
  • Programming (Scripting) experience along with ability to write custom integrations or tailored

Pay transparency

$180,000—$202,000 USD

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Team

The Security Operations Team at Harness is a small, high-leverage organization responsible for how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats across our cloud environment and the platform we run for customers. We measure ourselves against NIST CSF 2.0 and work closely with Cloud Security, IAM, Product Security, and Platform Engineering. We design for assume-breach: layered preventive controls, strong identity as the perimeter, and fast detection and response.

The Role

We are looking for a Director to own Security Operations (SOC), Detection Engineering, and Incident Response at Harness. You will build and lead the team that monitors our environment, engineers high-quality detections, and responds to incidents, and you will be accountable for how quickly and reliably we find and contain threats.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You are expected to stay close to the technical work, set the detection and response strategy, and build the team, tooling, and metrics that make Security Operations scalable.

What You Will Do

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Lead the SOC, including monitoring, triage, escalation, and on-call coverage, and manage any external SOC or managed detection and response (MDR) partners.
  • Own the incident response lifecycle: runbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication for high-severity incidents, and post-incident reviews that drive lasting fixes.
  • Define and report operational metrics such as detection coverage, alert quality, mean time to detect, and mean time to respond.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, and Customer Success on incident communication and customer or regulatory notification obligations.

Detection Engineering

  • Set the detection strategy and roadmap, with detections mapped to attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK) and prioritized by real risk to Harness and our customers.
  • Build a detection-as-code practice with peer review, testing standards, and a managed detection backlog.
  • Ensure the right telemetry is collected across cloud, Kubernetes, identity, endpoint, SaaS, and CI/CD systems, and partner with platform teams to close gaps.
  • Validate detections through purple-team exercises and testing, and tune continuously to reduce noise.

Automation & Tooling

  • Own the SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging stack, including roadmap, budget, and vendor relationships.
  • Reduce manual work through automation and AI-assisted triage and investigation, with human review where it matters.
  • Integrate threat intelligence and threat hunting into detection and response workflows.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Hire, coach, and develop SOC analysts and detection engineers, and build a sustainable on-call culture.
  • Partner with Cloud Security and IAM to align detection coverage with infrastructure and identity controls.
  • Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners and executive-ready reporting.
  • Support customer trust by contributing to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews.
  • Present security operations posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or security engineering, with 5+ years leading technical teams.
  • Experience leading a SOC or detection and response function, including leading team leads or senior engineers.
  • Hands-on depth in detection engineering: you have written, tuned, and retired detections across SIEM, EDR, and cloud telemetry.
  • Proven experience as incident commander or senior leader on significant security incidents.
  • Strong experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native logging, and with automation using scripting (such as Python).
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Kubernetes from a detection and response perspective.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

Preferred

  • Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.
  • Experience building detection-as-code pipelines and measuring detection quality.
  • Experience managing MDR or co-managed SOC relationships with accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience applying AI to triage, investigation, or detection engineering.
  • Experience with threat intelligence and threat hunting programs.

Software Engineer - Global Memberships Platform

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineer - Global Memberships Platform

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers growth at a global scale for all three of our brands: Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

Our team, Global Membership Platform, owns the core platform capabilities that drive the subscription model, which is key to our business. We build and run the shared services behind how customers join, manage and benefit from our membership offerings, giving every brand a single, reliable and scalable foundation to launch and evolve its membership proposition. Because membership is a paid product, we work closely with the Money team on payments, from how members are charged and billed to how payment outcomes feed back into their membership, so correctness and reliability are central to what we build. As a new team, we have a clear mandate and plenty of room to shape it: designing platform services that work across brands and regions, keeping a business-critical, always-on system dependable, and partnering with engineers, product and design teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt to bring membership together as one global platform.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us build and maintain high-performance systems that power our global marketplace, ensuring a seamless experience for millions of users. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a multi-disciplinary engineering team focused on technical execution and collaboration. As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals across your team, simplifying the maintenance of production systems while ensuring operational readiness and health.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team's remit, developing, releasing and running large-scale web applications whilst transitioning our monolithic codebase to a microservice-based architecture

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features, whilst defining the backend architecture and tech stack for a product area

  • Optimise Operations:Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our backend systems

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

  • Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.

  • Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).

  • Data Proficiency: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and "NoSQL" backends like Redis, DynamoDB, or ElasticSearch.

  • Systems at Scale: Proven ability to manage web architecture at scale (handling 20krpm and above).

jobs.title: Sr People Partner
jobs.description:
Sr People Partner

Vantage is growing, and we need a Sr People Partner to help our leaders become great ones. Your core client group is engineering managers, along with new managers and team leads across the business. Your job is to build a culture where coaching drives performance and where people feel it in their day-to-day experience at Vantage. You model the leadership you coach. You give managers candid advice, earn trust through sound judgment and follow-through, and hold leaders accountable for how they lead.

This is a hands-on business partner role. You’ll coach managers through difficult conversations, run performance cycles that focus on growth as much as evaluation and handle employee relations from first concern to resolution. You will lead projects that shape how we define and measure great work and use onboarding, exit interviews and people data to keep improving the employee experience. You’ll also advise on employment compliance across Canada, the US and the UK, support compensation planning, and help build fair, consistently applied policies.

Key Responsibilities

Business Partnering & Manager Coaching

  • Be the primary people partner for employees, people leaders and team leads across the business.

  • Equip managers to drive high performance through clear goals, ongoing feedback and real accountability, so great work gets recognized and issues get fixed early.

  • Build manager habits that drive a culture of performance: setting clear goals, coaching in the moment, recognizing top performers, and acting quickly when performance slips.

  • Advise on and manage employee relations matters, including performance improvement plans, written warnings, and terminations.

  • Help design and launch a leadership training program for new and developing managers.

Performance Management

  • Run the 90-day and Annual Review processes for your client groups, from manager preparation through to follow-up.

  • Help define our competencies and what great work looks like at Vantage, and build them into how we measure performance.

  • Build career planning frameworks that give employees a clear view of how they can grow here.

  • Own ER cases from first concern to resolution, including investigations into harassment and misconduct complaints.

  • Manage accommodations and leaves across jurisdictions with our Payroll and Benefits Specialist.

  • Escalate and partner with the Head of People on higher-risk matters.

Programs, Policy & Compliance

  • Refine People reporting so leaders have the data they need to make decisions.

  • Create company content that explains our people programs, policies, and changes.

  • Own the multi-jurisdiction handbook and support policy rollouts and manager training.

  • Prepare offer, promotion and merit recommendations using market data and our compensation philosophy.

  • Advise on employment standards across Ontario, BC, Alberta, the US (including California) and the UK through our EOR.

Employee Experience

  • Own and improve onboarding and exit interviews to improve the employee experience and lifecycle.

  • Support company events and initiatives, including in-person days, recruiting events, company retreats, and employee resource groups.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in an HR Business Partner role.

  • Experience at a scaling SaaS or technology company including experience partnering with engineering teams.

  • Hands-on ER experience, including investigations, PIPs and terminations.

  • Strong knowledge of performance management, competency frameworks.

  • Sound judgment, discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to give leaders direct coaching and feedback.

  • Ontario employment law knowledge; US/California exposure is an asset.

  • Experience with comp planning or pay equity.

  • Nice to have: PEO/EOR experience and CHRP/CHRL are assets.

About Vantage
Vantage is the first unified platform purpose-built for retail media orchestration, empowering enterprise retailers to seamlessly activate onsite, offsite, and in-store advertising. With a global presence in North America and Asia-Pacific, Vantage enables retailers to launch and grow their media networks through scalable technology and automated workflows, and is trusted by leading retailers like The Home Depot to power their retail media programs.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

About the Role

You will partner closely with Product and Product Marketing to turn each release into field-ready technical content, and you will measure readiness and program effectiveness so that the function earns its place as a trusted partner to the field and to leadership.

jobs.title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
jobs.description:
Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler

About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

  • Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation
  • Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies
  • Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together
  • Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems
  • Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization.
  • Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.
  • Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation
  • Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus
  • Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation
  • Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning
  • Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus
  • Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.
  • A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture
  • A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

Marketing Campaigns and Programs Associate

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

In this role, you'll own the day-to-day execution of our webinar program, both Harness-hosted and third-party, from vendor sourcing and speaker management through promotion and results reporting, while also supporting marketing campaigns and additional growth marketing programs as needed.

  • Bring creative thinking to operationalize and scale demand generation programs, building repeatable playbooks and processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally with marketing, content, product marketing, sales, and external partners.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where creativity meets accountability.

jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - DACH
jobs.description:
Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - DACH

Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working across EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. We already work with some well-known teams in the region, and we’ve recently announced an EMEA data centre. We want to invest properly in the community there, and we know that needs to be led by someone local. Someone who knows the market, speaks the language and understands how TA teams in the region actually work. You’ll own the DACH community end to end, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in Germany regularly, plus travel to another DACH (or wider EMEA) country every month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead DACH Community Events

    • Run community events across target DACH markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

  • You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

  • You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, and have a strong understanding of how hiring works in DACH

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

  • You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

  • You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

  • You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

  • You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

  • You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

  • You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

  • You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

  • You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

  • You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs across the DACH region

  • You aren’t fluent in both German and English

Interview Plan

  • Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

  • Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

  • Assignment (written) - 2 hours

    • Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

  • Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - EMEA

Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working in EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. You’ll own it across our target markets (UK&I, France, Nordics and Benelux), from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in London regularly, plus one trip to another EMEA city a month, usually for around four days. Busier periods can mean two trips abroad in a month. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead EMEA Community Events

    • Run community events across target EMEA markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

  • You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

  • You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

  • You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

  • You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

  • You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

  • You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

  • You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

  • You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

  • You’re uncomfortable with moderating discussions or being a speaker

  • You’d rather focus purely on the community side and aren’t keen to understand how it connects to the wider business

  • You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs such as London, Paris, Berlin, Stockholm and Amsterdam.

Interview Plan

  • Recruiter Screen with Kayla/Willem - 30 minutes

  • Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

  • Cross-functional Panel - 1 hour

  • Assignment (written) - 2 hours

    • Followed by Assignment Review with Kayla - 30 Minutes

  • Final Round - 1-1.5 hours

Benefits

  • Compelling benefits offerings, location dependent

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer (Colorado/Missouri)
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Engineer (Colorado/Missouri)

Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

About the Role

Horizon3 is redefining how organizations defend themselves against modern cyber threats. Our autonomous security platform, NodeZero, helps companies proactively find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do.

We’re looking for a Sales Engineer (open to mid to senior level) to partner closely with our Account Executives and help growing organizations understand the technical and business value of our platform. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in high-velocity environments, can simplify complex security concepts, and enjoys building trusted relationships with customers.

Location Requirement: Colorado or Kansas City, Missouri

What You’ll Do

Be a trusted technical partner in Mid-Enterprise or Enterprise deals
 Work alongside AEs to support discovery, solution positioning, and technical validation across mid-sized organizations with diverse environments.

Lead discovery and technical qualification
 Meet with prospective customers to understand their infrastructure, security maturity, compliance requirements, and risk priorities.

Deliver tailored demos and PoVs
 Run compelling, outcome-driven demos and proof-of-value engagements that clearly connect NodeZero’s capabilities to customer risk reduction and business impact.

Maintain continuity through the customer lifecycle
 Stay connected with key accounts to track evolving needs, ensure continued value realization, and surface expansion opportunities where it makes sense to.

Translate technical depth into business value
 Help customers understand not just how the platform works, but why it matters—framing results in terms of exposure reduction, compliance alignment, and operational efficiency.

Own technical deal strategy
 Navigate objections, competitive positioning, and technical concerns throughout the sales cycle.

Collaborate cross-functionally
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to ensure field feedback informs roadmap and positioning.

Support enablement and knowledge sharing
 Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and continuously refine demo flows, technical assets, and playbooks for the Mid-Market segment.

Own post-close technical continuity

Stay engaged after the deal closes to ensure a smooth technical handoff, reinforce initial value, and maintain executive and practitioner alignment—remaining attentive to adoption, impact, and expansion signals

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally in cybersecurity or infrastructure

  • Located in SouthWest Region of the United States

  • Experience working Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts with a mix of technical depth and executive interaction

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals (threat landscape, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, AD, etc.)

  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for both practitioners and executives

  • Experience running structured PoVs and managing technical validation cycles

  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent experience)

What Success Looks Like

  • You build strong, trust-based relationships with Mid-Market/Enterprise customers

  • PoVs are structured, outcome-driven, and consistently demonstrate clear value

  • You partner seamlessly with AEs and contribute meaningfully to pipeline progression and win rates

  • Customer feedback informs ongoing product and positioning improvements

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • $240k - $270k OTE 70/30 Split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
