jobs.title: Mission Director - Army
jobs.description:
Mission Director - Army

This position offers a base salary of $145,000 - $185,000. (Total on-target earnings of $290,000 to $370,000)

Role Description:

The Mission Director is a quota-carrying, full-lifecycle business owner responsible for identifying, shaping, closing, and executing new business within the Army specifically targeting PAE Maneuver Air.

You will build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes (our customers), identify meaningful problems, shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products, and lead opportunities from initial discovery through contract award. Once awarded, you will remain accountable for the contract throughout its lifecycle, including cost, schedule, performance, staffing, margin, and customer satisfaction.

This role is designed for someone who wants broad ownership. As the portfolio grows in size and complexity, Mission Directors will increasingly lead through program managers and delivery leaders while retaining accountability for portfolio outcomes.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Build the Business

  • Identify and develop net-new Army Aviation opportunities and build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes and key stakeholders.
  • Own a quota and grow a diversified portfolio of business.

Shape and Close Opportunities

  • Define customer problems, scope, and desired outcomes to shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products and the right acquisition approach.
  • Lead opportunities through proposal, negotiation, and contract award.

Own Contract Execution

  • Serve as the program leader for new contracts you close, with direct responsibility for execution until the portfolio reaches the scale where additional program management support is warranted.
  • Manage delivery risks, scope changes, and mission outcomes.

Build and Lead the Team

  • Define and build the team required to execute each contract. Personally lead contract execution and, as the portfolio grows, lead program managers and other delivery leaders across the portfolio.

Grow the Portfolio

  • Maintain an active pipeline and continue developing new opportunities while executing existing contracts by identifying follow-on work, expansions, and adjacent opportunities.
  • Own customer retention, portfolio growth, and gross margin.
  • Grow from individual contract ownership into a broader portfolio leadership role.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Experience within Army Aviation or a closely related defense environment.
  • Strong understanding of the culture, mission, stakeholders, and terminology within the domain you support.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: military operations, government program management, acquisition, contracting, business development, or defense industry program leadership.
  • Working knowledge of federal acquisition, including contract vehicles, acquisition strategies, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort owning revenue-generating activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and hold accountability for outcomes.
  • Willingness to operate across business development, contracting, staffing, and execution, personally driving critical work while building and leading the teams required to scale.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and creating a path forward without a predefined playbook.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to understand and communicate Defense Unicorns products, cloud-native technologies, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and modern software delivery concepts.

Candidates located near major Army hubs are preferred.

Ability to travel approximately 25-40%.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Staff QE, Mobile
jobs.description:
Staff QE, Mobile

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

Principal Engineer, Balance of Plant Auxiliary Systems

Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead the technical deployment of KP-FHR balance of plant (BOP) auxiliary systems engineering, including service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems. Reporting to the Balance of Plant (Power Generation System and Turbine Island) Leader, you will develop technical design solutions to enable the rapid deployment and integration of KP-FHR Balance of Plant Structures, Systems and Components (SSCs). This role requires a senior individual contributor with extensive experience in thermal and balance of plant technologies to ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the plant's balance of plant auxiliary systems.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the design and deployment of the balance of plant auxiliary systems, focusing on service water, treated water, chilled water, component cooling water, and compressed air systems including pumps, valves, and related auxiliary systems that meet Kairos Power’s FHR deployment objectives.
  • Manage and coordinate external partners, suppliers, regulators and vendors related to BOP auxiliary systems.
  • Support supplier technical oversight, including review of supplier deliverables, technical deviations, test plans, and component qualification evidence while performing independent verification calculations as necessary.
  • Develop and approve system documentation deliverables as required by the project.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate the balance of plant auxiliary systems with overall plant design and operations.
  • Lead or support formal design reviews, interface reviews, hazard reviews, and technical readiness reviews for balance of plant components and subsystems.
  • Apply engineering principles and engineering codes & standards, such as ASME and ANSI, to the design, analysis, and evaluation of systems.
  • Lead design trade studies, performance analyses and optimization of balance of plant auxiliary systems to meet commercial and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee the preparation of technical specifications, design documents, and system drawings for all balance of plant auxiliary systems components.
  • Perform feasibility studies and risk assessments related to commercial balance of plant auxiliary systems technologies and subsystems.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of technical concepts and strategies.
  • Support commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of the balance of plant auxiliary systems during the plant's startup phase.
  • Stay abreast of industry advancements, best practices, and emerging balance of plant technologies.
  • Develop and maintain system requirements, interface control documents, design bases, and verification/validation plans for balance of plant components.
  • Perform work within established scope, budgetary and schedule requirements.
  • Resolve complex technical issues and system/interface conflicts affecting BOP auxiliary system design, procurement, installation, testing, or commissioning.
  • Evaluate proposed design changes and technical deviations for impact on system requirements, interfaces, design basis, safety, quality, and configuration control.
  • Establish and maintain technical acceptance criteria for BOP auxiliary system components and subsystems, including criteria used for procurement, testing, and verification.
  • Provide technical disposition and recommendations for nonconforming conditions, test results, or equipment performance issues within assigned BOP systems.
  • Ensure design decisions, analyses, and technical resolutions are documented and traceable to applicable requirements, design inputs, and verification evidence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • M.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years experience in the design and operation of balance of plant systems, particularly in the nuclear or thermal power sectors
  • Demonstrated experience in managing complex engineering projects and leading technical teams, with thorough understanding of evaluation, design, and licensing of a new technology
  • Demonstrated experience of physical hardware deployment in heat transfer and water treatment systems
  • Experience with requirements management, systems engineering, or design control processes for complex engineered systems.
  • Experience reviewing or developing technical specifications, procurement documents, test plans, or acceptance criteria for major equipment.
  • Experience applying engineering codes and standards relevant to BOP auxiliary systems, including applicable ASME, ASTM, ICC, ISO, and MSS standards. Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated vendor engagement and management skills
  • Strong understanding of heat transfer principles, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics as they relate to balance of plant systems
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for balance of plant systems. Experience with nuclear power applications is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of optimizing system performance in novel applications
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills; must be able to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization including external partners
  • Ability to work with a highly collaborative team
  • Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently
  • Prioritizes and demonstrates a nuclear safety culture
  • Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge
  • Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges, and issues
  • Knowledge of system integration, interface management, and verification/validation practices.
  • Ability to apply safety, quality, and configuration management principles to engineering design activities.
  • Ability to apply engineering judgment to evaluate design alternatives, technical risks, and trade-offs and develop defensible technical recommendations.
  • Knowledge of requirements development, allocation, traceability, and verification for complex engineered systems.
  • Ability to evaluate technical specifications, supplier deliverables, test plans, deviations, and qualification evidence against design requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to interpret and apply applicable engineering codes, standards, and design criteria to BOP system and component design.

Physical Demands

Travel

Additional Requirements

Location: Remote — United States
Security Clearance: Active Secret Required

Solve Clinical Workflow Challenges. Strengthen Healthcare Technology.

Reliable clinical applications enable healthcare professionals to deliver effective, coordinated care. Rackner is seeking an experienced Clinical Workflow Analyst to diagnose complex electronic health record (EHR) issues, restore functional workflows, and strengthen application reliability in mission-critical federal healthcare environments.

In this hands-on role, you'll apply your EHR expertise to resolve challenging application issues, manage cases through confirmed resolution, and identify opportunities to improve clinical technology operations. Working alongside clinical, technical, and service management teams, you'll contribute to dependable healthcare systems, better user experiences, and continuous operational improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate and diagnose complex Tier II/III clinical application and workflow issues, identifying functional disruptions and determining appropriate resolution paths.

  • Evaluate the functional impact of application releases and changes, identifying workflow implications and communicating findings to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide functional application expertise during priority incidents, contributing to troubleshooting and coordinated resolution through case closure.
  • Analyze service tickets and available application performance data to identify recurring challenges and recommend improvements to training, user adoption, and automation processes.
  • Provide functional application assistance during go-lives and clinical unit transitions, including occasional onsite engagement to address issues and facilitate operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience supporting electronic health records (EHR) or clinical applications.
  • Direct professional experience supporting clinical workflows within designated military healthcare EHR environments.
  • Professional experience handling application support cases using ServiceNow.
  • Active U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EHR utilization analytics and application performance insights tools.

Why Rackner?

At Rackner, you'll contribute to meaningful federal healthcare technology initiatives that help clinical teams work more effectively. We value practical problem-solving, technical curiosity, accountability, and professionals who take ownership of delivering reliable solutions.

Good Maven is supporting Fin in hiring Senior, Staff & Principal Product Designer

Dublin, London, Berlin - Remote

Designer to push the boundaries of product craft.

We are one of the most design-driven and AI first technology companies. Fin, our AI Agent is
the best performing, most widely adopted, and highest grossing AI service agent on the
market. We are shaping the future of how businesses communicate with their customers
through AI and humans. Our product is used by millions, and our design team plays a critical
role in making it world-class.

Why you should join Fin today

AI is transforming everything—fast. We’re at the forefront, shaping the AI Agent category
and redefining customer service with Fin. Soon, Fin will handle the vast majority of customer
interactions, setting a new standard for support.
This shift isn’t just changing what we build—it’s changing how we work. Our team is
constantly evolving, integrating AI into design, development, and go-to-market strategies.
At Fin, design is in our DNA. With 60+ designers across R&D and Brand—and two
co-founders from design—you’ll never have to fight for your place at the table. Here,
designers lead from the start, shaping products that millions of people interact with daily. If
you want to work on cutting-edge AI experiences that push the boundaries of product
design, there’s no better place to be.

Why this role exists


In a world where it’s easier and easier to get software off the ground and to 75% built, it’s the
last 25% that really matters. We need deep craft specialists—people who will raise the
quality bar, bring a spark of creativity, drive best-in-class interaction and visual design, and
push execution excellence across our most strategic product areas. This is not a
strategy-only or people-management role. We need a maker, a doer, a leader in craft.
If you have a deep passion for interaction design, product thinking, and pixel-perfect
execution—and the leadership and autonomy to drive impact without waiting for
direction—this is the role for you.

Must Have Experience
We’re looking for a world-class IC designer who:

 

  • Has shipped complex, high-quality software products.

  • Designs for multiple surfaces—desktop, mobile, chat interfaces, AI first and
    emerging experiences.

  • Balances speed and detail—knows when to move fast and when to obsess over
    the last 1%.

  • Thinks end-to-end—from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction
    detail.

  • Understands engineering and can build prototypes to communicate ideas (Framer,
    Loveable, Windsurf, Vercel, Figma, code etc…).

  • Has taste. You know what great design looks and feels like, and you push to get
    there.

  • Can tell a compelling story—articulating your decisions with clarity and conviction.

  • Operates with agency, ownership, and autonomy—doesn’t wait to be told what to
    do.


Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not for you if:

  • You prefer strategy, research or system design over execution—this is a
    craft-heavy role.

  • You need a lot of direction or structured processes—you should thrive in
    open-endedness and ambiguity.

  • You don’t obsess over details—we’re looking for someone who sweats the pixels.

  • You primarily work on marketing sites—this role is about designing deep,
    functional software experiences.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing:

  • Owning end-to-end design for high-impact product areas from concept to
    execution.

  • Defining new interaction patterns and design paradigms for Fin, our automation,
    and AI-powered tools.

  • Sketching, prototyping, and testing ideas at different fidelities to validate
    decisions.

  • Working closely with engineers and PMs to define problems, move quickly, and
    deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Maintaining high standards of craft while balancing speed and execution.

  • Contributing to design culture—mentoring others, pushing for greatness in a team,
    refining processes, and sharing knowledge inside and outside Fin.

 

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re successful if:

  1. You’ve raised the design bar. Your work is referenced as an example of
    exceptional craft and taste.

  2. You’ve shipped product with major business impact. The areas you own are
    visibly better because of you.

  3. You operate autonomously. You don’t need direction—you see what needs to be
    done and do it.

  4. Engineers love working with you. Your designs are considered, clear, and easy
    to implement.

  5. Your peers trust your judgment. When you push for quality, people listen.

Interview Process
We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time and energy consuming–we aim
to be thorough, speedy and transparent in our approach. You should expect for the entire
process to be no more than 4 weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with various members of
our team and have the opportunity to fully validate that Fin and the role is the right fit for you.
Ready to build something great?


If you're driven to push the boundaries of product design and have the craft, autonomy, and
taste to make a real impact, we want to hear from you.

Senior Solutions Architect

At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary
ExtraHop’s Solutions Architecture team is very different from many other post-sales services practices—we focus on outcomes and customer success rather than racking up billable hours. As a member of our Solutions Architecture team, you’ll play a critical role in the success of our customers, products and position in the marketplace. Our Architects tackle the most difficult business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. As a Solutions Architect at ExtraHop, you will never be bored again.

In this Senior Solutions Architect role, you will serve as a Field Architect, supporting various Enterprise customers in a post-sales architecture capacity. This customer-facing role serves a global customer base, so it calls for polished, professional communication and conduct, and the ability to adapt your communication and working approach to the norms and expectations of customers across different cultures and regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced GUI development
  • Advanced Trigger Script development
  • Intermediate external REST API script development
  • Intermediate understanding of networking
  • Intermediate understanding of application design
  • Understand, develop, and implement Cloud network design in AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Work with SOC and Incident Response Teams on workflows using network data. Decrease Mean-time-to-Respond.
  • Develop custom tools using Python and JavaScript-based APIs to extend the functionality of the ExtraHop platform.
  • Develop customized data analysis to monitor changing technical and business conditions in real-time.
  • Create rich data visualizations to aid tactical investigations and realize strategic objectives.
  • Create automated tools to streamline repeatable processes and maximize time spent building intelligent solutions.
  • Conduct hands-on learning sessions with key customer personnel.

Required Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of relevant experience
  • BS degree or equivalent
  • Experience in customer-facing positions; excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strong understanding of Network Detection technologies and a background in packet analysis.
  • Understanding of core networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (HTTP, SQL, CIFS/NFS, HL7, Memcache, DNS)
  • Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, GCP, and Azure
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python and JavaScript
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Independence, motivation, and desire for practice ownership

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Redditâs analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience.

In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. You will design and ship capabilities, maintain and improve existing systems, and work with applied scientists and data scientists to make advanced analysis accessible. You will remain close to the code and to the people using it, from an initial prototype through rollout, operation, and ongoing refinement.

Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve the software that powers our analytics agent and shared analytical workflows, including backend services, reusable libraries, APIs, and integrations with data and scientific tools.
  • Design reliable agent workflows: context retrieval, planning and orchestration, structured tool calls, execution state, result validation, and clear handling of incomplete or failed tasks.
  • Develop evaluation infrastructure and use it continuously. Maintain versioned task sets, automated checks, human-reviewed examples, regression reports, and release gates that expose meaningful failures.
  • Improve agent quality through careful failure analysis and measured changes to prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflow design, balancing correctness, latency, and cost.
  • Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.
  • Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.
  • Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.
  • Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.
  • Work directly with users to prioritize recurring needs, support adoption and migrations, and measure whether the platform helps people complete analytical work successfully.

Required qualifications

  • Substantial professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production services, platforms, or developer tools from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Five or more years is a useful sourcing guideline.
  • Strong programming ability, including production Python, and sound engineering fundamentals in API design, data modeling, automated testing, code review, distributed systems, and debugging.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying tool-using agents or multi-step LLM applications, with concrete understanding of context, structured outputs, orchestration, state, and model failure modes.
  • Experience designing and using evals to improve AI systems: representative cases, baselines, failure analysis, grader limitations, and quality criteria that influence what ships.
  • Practical experience with service reliability, authorization, queues or asynchronous execution, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and operational monitoring.
  • Working fluency in SQL and experience integrating data-intensive services or analytical tools; an ability to preserve data provenance and documented analytical constraints.
  • A record of leading substantial technical work with other engineers and partner teams, explaining tradeoffs clearly, and helping others contribute effectively.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with analytics agents, text-to-SQL, data discovery, notebook or code-execution environments, or internal platforms for data scientists.
  • Experience with agent evaluation harnesses, tool protocols such as MCP, model gateways, retrieval systems, or secure sandboxed execution.
  • Experience building reusable scientific libraries, packaging statistical methods behind stable APIs, or collaborating closely with scientists on validation.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI

Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier.

We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts.
  • Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface.
    • Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly.
    • Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed.
    • Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results.
  • Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution.
  • Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate.
  • Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations.
  • Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration.
  • You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring.
  • You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language.
  • You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS.
  • You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls.
  • Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role.

You will love this job if:

  • You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice.
  • You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it.
  • You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it.
  • You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â 
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Cloverâs inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of oneâs identity. All of our employeeâs points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.description:
Director, Product Marketing (Contractor)

About the Role

Glossier is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Product Marketing leader to oversee product marketing across our portfolio during a maternity leave.

This person will play a critical role in bringing our product portfolio to life, leading go-to-market strategy for new launches, building enduring equity around our most iconic products, and translating product truths and consumer insights into compelling, culturally relevant storytelling that builds brand desire and drives commercial results.

Sitting at the intersection of Product Development, Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, and Commercial teams, this role will connect product innovation with consumer needs and business objectivesâtranslating what makes our products special into clear positioning, impactful campaigns, and commercially successful launches.

We're looking for someone who can balance big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate a fast-moving environment, and confidently drive projects and decisions forward.

Key Responsibilities

Product Positioning & Strategy

  • Own product marketing strategy across Glossier's portfolio, including new product launches, existing icons, and key commercial moments.
  • Develop compelling product positioning, consumer insights, key messaging, and points of differentiation that establish a clear role for each product within the Glossier portfolio and competitive landscape as needed.Â 
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen product equity, drive customer acquisition, and increase engagement and repurchase across existing products.
  • Partner closely with Product Development to understand product innovation, benefits, claims, and competitive differentiation, translating technical product information into meaningful consumer-facing storytelling.
  • Help shape future portfolio strategy by identifying market trends, consumer needs, competitive opportunities, and potential assortment gaps.

Go-to-Market Leadership

  • Lead product marketing workstreams for upcoming launches, from early positioning and strategy through launch execution.
  • Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies that establish target audiences, product positioning, key messaging, launch objectives, and commercial opportunities.
  • Lead cross-functional GTM kickoffs, ensuring teams are aligned on product strategy, consumer insights, launch priorities, and key deliverables.
  • Partner with Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, and Education to ensure product positioning is translated consistently and effectively across all consumer touchpoints.
  • Bring strong creative judgment and strategic guidance throughout the creative development process, ensuring campaigns build brand desire, communicate meaningful product differentiation, and deliver against commercial objectives.
  • Manage multiple launches and priorities simultaneously, keeping teams aligned and workstreams moving forward.

Portfolio & Commercial Performance

  • Analyze sales performance, consumer feedback, and competitive trends to inform marketing strategies and future product decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to reinvigorate existing products through new storytelling, strategic marketing moments, and customer acquisition initiatives.
  • Support portfolio planning, assortment decisions, and product lifecycle management, including product introductions, discontinuations, and reformulations.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product marketing strategies support brand and commercial objectives across DTC, Sephora, and retail channels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build effective partnerships with Product Development, Creative, Brand, Integrated Marketing, Education, Retail, Wholesale, and Commercial teams.
  • Represent the consumer perspective throughout the product development and launch process, advocating for clarity, relevance, and differentiation.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff of strategic decisions, deliverables, and ongoing workstreams throughout the coverage period.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, or a related strategic marketing function, ideally within beauty, skincare, makeup, or consumer brands.
  • Demonstrated experience leading product launches and developing go-to-market strategies from concept through execution.
  • Strong understanding of the beauty landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and emerging category trends.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex product benefits into compelling, consumer-friendly messaging.
  • Strong commercial acumen and comfort using performance data, consumer insights, and market research to inform decisions.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • A genuine passion for beauty, product innovation, and the Glossier brand.

What Success Looks Like

  • Key product launches remain on track, with clear positioning, strong cross-functional alignment, and compelling go-to-market strategies.
  • Product storytelling is consistent, differentiated, and grounded in both consumer insights and commercial objectives.
  • Existing hero products continue to receive strategic marketing support, with opportunities for growth proactively identified.
  • Cross-functional partners feel supported, informed, and empowered to execute against shared priorities.
  • A seamless transition of workstreams and strategic context is maintained throughout the maternity leave coverage period.

Employment Type: Temporary / Maternity Leave Coverage
Duration: Approximately 4â5 months
